text: This is revealed to be because , shortly before Lalo 's death , he had revealed to Jimmy Nacho 's role in the failed assassination attempt against him and Lalo implied that he believed that Jimmy was involved as well .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Lalo had promised to return for the full story later , but he died before he could and Jimmy had lived in fear of Lalo returning to keep his promise .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Chuck McGill

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Charles Lindbergh McGill Jr. ( portrayed by Michael McKean ) is Jimmy McGill 's older brother .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: He is a named partner at one of Albuquerque 's most prestigious law firms , Hamlin , Hamlin & McGill ( HHM ) , which he co-founded with Howard Hamlin 's father .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: A brilliant man who holds himself and others to high ideals , Chuck firmly believes that doing the right thing is the only true path to success .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Chuck is critical of Jimmy 's background as a scam artist , and after Jimmy was arrested in Chicago , Chuck secured his release on the condition that Jimmy get a legitimate job in HHM 's mail room .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: To Chuck 's surprise , Jimmy was inspired to pursue his own law degree , hoping to also become an attorney at HHM .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Because Chuck does not consider Jimmy a " real " lawyer , he worked behind Jimmy 's back to prevent him from being hired .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Chuck was married to Rebecca Bois , which ended in divorce ; around this time , Chuck began to believe he had electromagnetic hypersensitivity , which forced him to semi-retire from HHM .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Prior to and in the early part of Better Call Saul , Jimmy tends to Chuck 's daily care .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: When Jimmy discovers potential fraud at the Sandpiper retirement community , Chuck identifies relevant evidence and helps Jimmy prepare the initial case files .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Because of the case 's size , Chuck suggests that they give it to HHM , but Jimmy is stunned to learn they want the case but not his participation , a demand secretly made by Chuck .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Chuck begins to openly work against Jimmy 's law career once Jimmy finds out the truth .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: When Kim is later denied recognition for securing the Mesa Verde account for HHM , Jimmy secretly introduces an error in Chuck 's paperwork , leading to Kim establishing a practice with Mesa Verde as her only client .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: This escalates the brothers ' feud , with Chuck deceiving Jimmy into admitting guilt , then using the recorded confession in an effort to have Jimmy disbarred .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Jimmy is suspended for a year after he uses the bar association hearing to prove Chuck 's illness is psychosomatic , but is not disbarred .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Jimmy cuts ties with Chuck and requests that Howard take over Chuck 's care .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Chuck attempts to overcome his illness but Jimmy " accidentally " informs his malpractice insurer of Chuck 's condition .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: The insurer threatens higher rates for HHM unless Chuck is constantly supervised .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Chuck wants to fight but Howard buys out Chuck 's share , effectively firing him .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Chuck relapses and in the season 3 finale " Lantern " , he kills himself by intentionally knocking over a lantern which causes a fatal fire .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: The fallout of Chuck 's tragic death lingers on to affect Jimmy , Kim and Howard as the series progresses .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Lalo Salamanca

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Eduardo " Lalo " Salamanca ( portrayed by Tony Dalton ) is another of Hector 's nephews , introduced in season 4 of Better Call Saul .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: He arrives from Mexico soon after Hector 's stroke to help run the family 's drug operation , and takes a greater interest in the day - to - day details than Hector did , which makes Nacho uneasy .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Lalo visits Hector in the nursing home and enables Hector to communicate more effectively by giving him a front desk call bell , which Lalo kept as a souvenir after Hector killed a hotelier .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Lalo thanks Gus for giving Hector first aid after his stroke and paying for his care , but also surveils Gus 's subordinates in order to learn their regular activities .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: When Werner escapes from Mike 's supervision , Lalo follows Mike and kills Fred , a money wire store clerk , to obtain Werner 's location .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: He becomes aware that Werner was constructing something for Gus and Gus fabricates a story to explain events of which Lalo is aware , which Lalo outwardly accepts while remaining suspicious .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Lalo disrupts Gus 's activities and places trust in Nacho , unaware Nacho is Gus 's mole .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Lalo allows Krazy - 8 to become a DEA informant with Jimmy 's help , and Krazy - 8 turns over locations of Gus 's dead drops .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Gus has Mike link Lalo to Fred 's murder to get him arrested , but later has Jimmy arrange for his bail of $ 7 million .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Lalo convinces Jimmy to pick up the cash from Leonel and Marco at a remote desert location .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Jimmy is nearly killed by the cartel , who believe it best to keep Lalo in prison to protect Gus 's business , but Mike arrives to save him .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: After Jimmy 's car breaks down , Mike and Jimmy trek through the desert over two days before reaching safety .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Jimmy provides Lalo a cover story to hide Mike 's involvement , which Lalo accepts .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: He intends to skip bail and return to Mexico , but instead of waiting for Leonel and Marco to pick him up , he searches for Jimmy 's car .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: He returns to Albuquerque to confront Jimmy at Kim 's apartment , and reveals that he found Jimmy 's car , which was full of bullet holes .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Kim says passersby probably shot at the car for fun and accuses Lalo of not trusting Jimmy .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Lalo then instructs Nacho to drive him to Mexico , but not the original pickup site .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: In Mexico , he introduces Nacho to Don Eladio and informs him that Nacho will run the Salamanca drug business while Lalo hides from the authorities .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Gus arranges an assassination attempt on Lalo with Nacho 's help , but Lalo survives .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: He fakes his death , then travels to Germany under an alias to find proof that Gus is disloyal to the cartel .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: After conversing with Werner Ziegler 's widow Margarethe and later breaking into her house , he finds clues that lead him to Casper , a member of Werner 's construction crew .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Using details obtained from Casper , Lalo returns to Albuquerque and surveils Gus 's industrial laundry .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: He later arrives at Jimmy and Kim 's apartment .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Howard Hamlin had arrived shortly before Lalo ; confused , Howard fails to heed Jimmy and Kim 's entreaties to leave immediately , and Lalo kills him with a gunshot to the head .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Lalo instructs Jimmy to drive to Gus 's house and shoot him ; Jimmy convinces Lalo to send Kim instead , expecting Lalo to kill whoever remains behind .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Lalo binds and gags Jimmy , then takes Jimmy 's car to the laundry .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Mike thwarts Kim 's attempt to kill Gus , and sends his men to her apartment after she tells him Lalo is there with Jimmy .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: This allows Lalo to sneak into the laundry .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Gus goes to the laundry after realizing that Kim was sent as a distraction ; Lalo kills Gus 's bodyguards and forces Gus to show him the lab 's construction site , filming the encounter as proof of Gus 's disloyalty to the cartel .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Gus , however , triggers a power outage and kills Lalo with a gun he had hidden in the site earlier .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Lalo is buried beneath the lab 's floor alongside Howard .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Lalo and Nacho are mentioned in the Breaking Bad episode " Better Call Saul " .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Walter White and Jesse Pinkman kidnap Saul and attempt to coerce him into defending Badger after Badger is arrested for selling meth .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Saul believes that the masked Walter and Jesse are hitmen sent by Lalo and attempts to blame " Ignacio " for whatever wrong Lalo believes was done .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: In the episode " Breaking Bad " of Better Call Saul , shortly after Saul 's freakout , Jesse asks who Lalo is , given how scared Saul was of him .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Jesse notes that he has never heard Lalo 's name before amongst the street - level dealers and Saul brushes Lalo off as being " nobody " .

text: Law enforcement

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Getz ( portrayed by DJ Qualls ) is an Albuquerque police detective who takes part in an undercover operation that results in him arresting Badger Mayhew for possession of meth .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Steve Gómez

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Steven " Steve " Gómez ( played by Steven Michael Quezada ) , also nicknamed " Gomey " , is Hank 's Drug Enforcement Administration partner and friend .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: He is promoted to El Paso when Hank declines the transfer after witnessing a deadly attack on the Mexican border .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Gomez has been Hank 's right - hand man in the " Heisenberg " case since the beginning .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: After the Salamanca Brothers nearly kill Hank , Gomez starts performing tasks that Hank can not perform due to his handicap .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: At the end of Season 4 ( on Hank 's request ) , Gomez inspects Gus 's industrial laundry with police dog units , but finds no trace of the underground meth lab .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: After Walt and Jesse set fire to the lab , Gomez returns with Hank to find it destroyed , with little evidence remaining .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Gomez is the only DEA officer whom Hank tells about his revelation that Walter White is Heisenberg , and Gomez continues to be Hank 's partner through their final investigation , which leads to both the arrest of Walt and a shootout with Jack 's gang .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Gomez is killed in the gunfight , shortly before Hank is killed .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Gomez was originally supposed to die in the first season .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: However , when the 2007 – 2008 writers ' strike cut the season short , the writers reworked their ideas and he remained alive until the last season .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Quezada reprises his role as Gomez in Better Call Saul , appearing in the fifth season episode " The Guy for This " in which he and Hank interview Domingo " Krazy - 8 "

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Molina after Molina is arrested following the discovery of a drug house belonging to the Salamanca family .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Jimmy McGill , representing Molina as Saul Goodman , convinces Hank and Gomez to allow Molina to go free in exchange for Molina becoming a confidential informant .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Information provided by Molina leads to the discovery of " just shy of a million dollars " in drug money .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Kalanchoe and Munn

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Kalanchoe ( played by Gonzalo Menendez ) and Munn ( played by Jason Douglas ) are detectives with the Albuquerque Police Department ( APD ) , questioning Jesse first in regard to the poisoning of Brock Cantillo , and then in regard to the large amount of money he has been giving away .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: George Merkert Assistant special agent in charge George Merkert ( played by Michael Shamus Wiles ) is Hank 's boss at the DEA .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: He is impressed with Hank 's tenacity and hard work , and recommends him for a transfer to El Paso .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: When Hank returns to Albuquerque after being wounded , Merkert is frustrated by Hank 's stalling a second transfer to El Paso , unaware that Hank is having panic attacks and is afraid to go back .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: After Hank attacks Jesse , Merkert is forced to suspend Hank without pay but tells him off the record that Jesse will not press charges .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Following Hank 's shooting and subsequent recovery , Merkert welcomes Hank back to work but refuses to act on Hank 's suspicions of Gus Fring beyond a basic interview .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: When Gus is revealed to be a drug kingpin , Merkert is permanently relieved of his duties .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Austin Ramey Special Agent - in - Charge Austin Ramey ( played by Todd Terry ) is the head of the El Paso division of the DEA offices , and thus the highest ranking DEA agent appearing on the show .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: He appointed Hank to replace George Merkert as ASAC .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: He reappears in El Camino : A Breaking Bad Movie in which he gives a press conference watched by Skinny Pete and Badger on the massacre of Jack Welker 's gang by Walter White and the status of Jesse Pinkman .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Ramey also reappears in the series finale of Better Call Saul , during Jimmy McGill 's sentencing hearing .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: He is one of five characters ( along with Mike Ehrmantraut , Walter White , Jesse Pinkman , and Ed Galbraith ) to appear in each of Breaking Bad , Better Call Saul , and El Camino .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Tim Roberts Tim Roberts ( played by Nigel Gibbs ) is a detective with the Albuquerque Police Department , who works closely with Hank Schrader and the DEA under George Merkert 's watch .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Roberts first appears at the White household asking Skyler about Walt 's disappearance after Tuco Salamanca kidnaps both Walter and Jesse and takes them to his uncle 's house .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Hank asked Roberts to take the case of Walter 's disappearance as a personal favor to Hank , believing Walter had one of his " episodes " wherein he forgot where he was and would turn up days later .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Roberts next appears after Marie Schrader is arrested and taken to the police station for pilfering property at the open houses she visits .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Hank contacts Roberts after Marie tells Hank about her predicament .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Roberts gets the homeowners to drop their charges after their property is returned , and he takes Marie home for Hank .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Roberts also investigates Gale Boetticher 's murder .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: He consults with Hank after he finds Gale 's notebook and asks what all the notes and drawings mean , and whether or not Gale may have been working in a meth lab .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: This piques Hank 's interest in the case , and he embarks on his own investigation of Gale and his ties to Fring .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: The APD detectives ' investigation of Gale 's apartment yields Gus 's fingerprint , which gives the APD and the DEA probable cause to officially request that Fring come in for questioning .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Fring complies and then explains his ties to Boetticher , who won one of Gus 's Maximino Arciniega scholarships that Gale used to pursue degrees in chemistry .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Roberts is satisfied with Gus 's explanations of how he knew Boetticher and why he was in Boetticher 's home , but Hank remains dubious and continues investigating Fring and his personal and business dealings .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Roberts reappears in seasons 5 and 6 of Better Call Saul where he is the lead detective investigating the murder of Fred Whalen by Lalo Salamanca .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Mike Ehrmantraut , in an effort to get rid of Lalo , arranges for Roberts to get the evidence that he needs to connect Lalo to the murder and arrest him for it with Lalo using the alias of Jorge DeGuzman .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: However , due to Lalo 's continuing threat , Gus Fring has Mike help Saul Goodman get Lalo bail , much to the frustration of Roberts and the deputy district attorney in charge of the case .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Roberts and the DDA later confront Saul over " Jorge 's " fake family and subsequent disappearance , but Saul brushes off their questions .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: However , he accidentally slips up and refers to Lalo by his real first name , later allowing the authorities to identify Jorge DeGuzman as actually being Lalo Salamanca who has supposedly been recently killed in a shootout at his home .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Officer Saxton Officer Saxton ( played by Stoney Westmoreland ) is a member of the Albuquerque Police Department .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: He is called to the White residence when Skyler reports that Walt has illegally broken into her house .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Saxton reappears in Better Call Saul , where he is called to Daniel Wormald 's house in regard to the theft of his baseball cards .

text: Gus 's organization

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Max Arciniega Maximino Arciniega ( played by James Martinez ) is Gus Fring 's business associate and former romantic partner .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Gus paid for Max 's education in biochemistry and chemical engineering at the University of Santiago in Chile .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: The pair then moved to Mexico and opened a chain of Los Pollos Hermanos chicken restaurants together .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: In the drug business , Max is the chemist ; he cooked the crystal meth , samples of which he and Gus started giving away .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: These samples gained the attention of Don Eladio , a local drug lord , whom Max and Gus approached in the hope of convincing the Don to join them in the meth business .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Don Eladio , unimpressed by these upstarts and nominally dismissive of selling methamphetamine in lieu of cocaine , had Hector kill Max on the patio of his mansion .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Gus is forced by Juan Bolsa to watch as his partner 's fatal head wound bleeds into the swimming pool , a vision that stays with him .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: After moving to the US , Gus sets up a college scholarship in Max 's name ( which Gale Boetticher won one year ) and is determined to avenge his death .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: In the Better Call Saul episode " Dedicado a Max " , Gus is shown to have also dedicated a fountain to Max 's memory on the property of the ranch he owns in Mexico .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: The character Maximino Arciniega shares his name with the real - life actor who plays Krazy - 8 in Season 1 .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Gale Boetticher

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Gale Boetticher ( played by David Costabile ) is a chemist hired by Gus Fring to set up the underground meth lab and serve as Walt 's assistant .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: He holds an MS degree in organic chemistry , with a specialty in X - ray crystallography .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Gale pursued a doctorate in Colorado under an NSF grant but quit because he loved being in the lab and wanted to preserve the " magic " he saw in chemistry .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: He describes himself as a " nerd " and a libertarian .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: He is single , vegan , and well - cultured .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: He is a fan of foreign language music , speaks fluent Italian , and is fond of Walt Whitman .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: During the events of Better Call Saul , Gale is a post -graduate student and researcher at the University of New Mexico , and discreetly tests meth samples Gus provides as part of a plan to end his need for Mexican cartel cocaine .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Gale asserts he could make better quality meth himself , but Gus says he has bigger plans for Gale .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: The construction of the underground meth lab , which Werner Ziegler oversees , is revealed to have been done in accordance with Gale 's design .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: In a flashback within Breaking Bad , Gale selects and installs the meth lab 's production equipment .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: He analyzes the " blue meth " samples Gus provides and assures Gus it is the best meth he has ever seen .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: By the third season of Breaking Bad , Gale has broken in the lab 's equipment but has been waiting for Gus to hire Walt to cook blue meth .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: When Walt arrives , Gale expresses admiration and eagerness to learn .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Walt later needs to bring Jesse back into the business to make amends for Hank 's assault , so he convinces Gus to fire Gale and re-hire Jesse .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Jesse discovers Gus 's street dealers were responsible for the deaths of Combo and of Andrea 's brother , Tomás .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Before Jesse can kill the dealers , Walt runs them over with his car , then has Saul hide Jesse .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Gus re-hires Gale and instructs him to learn everything he can from Walt , supposedly because Walt has terminal cancer and Gus can not end meth production if Walt dies .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Walt recognizes that Gus is planning to kill him , so he instructs Jesse to learn Gale 's address .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Late one night , Mike and Victor take Walt to the lab on the pretense of solving an urgent problem only to reveal that they intend to kill him there .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Walt convinces them to let him call Jesse to hand him over , but he instead instructs Jesse to kill Gale .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Victor tries to beat Jesse to Gale 's apartment but Jesse arrives first and shoots Gale in the head , killing him instantly , which prevents Gus from killing Walt .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Gale 's death triggers several key events .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Because Victor is seen at Gale 's apartment by witnesses after he has been shot , Gus kills Victor as a warning to Walt and Jesse to cook meth without causing trouble .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Hank connects Gale 's death to Gus , the blue meth , and Heisenberg , and obsessively reviews Gale 's lab notes , especially a dedication to " W. W. " .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: While having dinner at Walt 's house , Hank finds the copy of Whitman 's Leaves of Grass Gale gave Walt , which includes the dedication " To my other favorite W. W. " in the same handwriting as Gale 's journal .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: This leads Hank to realize that Walt is Heisenberg .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Duane Chow Duane Chow ( played by James Ning ) is the owner of Golden Moth Chemical , an industrial chemical manufacturing company that supplies Gus 's drug empire .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: During Gus 's conflict with a Mexican drug cartel in Ciudad Juárez , the cartel enforcers come to Chow 's offices and hold him hostage .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Chow 's captors are later killed by Mike , who shoots Chow in the hand for not telling Gus about the situation .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: After Gus 's death , Chow starts being questioned by the DEA , as he was on Gus 's payroll at the time of Gus 's murder .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Chow is also on the list of eleven men whom Lydia suggests that Mike kill before they can make a plea deal with the DEA ( but Mike refuses ) .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Lydia then hires one of the eleven , Chris Mara , to kill the other ten , and adds Mike to the list .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Mara starts with Chow , whom he uses to lure Mike into a trap before shooting Chow in the head .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Mike thwarts the attempt on his own life after getting from Chris the information Lydia gave him , and then kills Chris .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Ron Forenall Ron Forenall ( played by Russ Dillen ) is Mike Ehrmantraut 's contact at Madrigal Electromotive 's chemical warehouse in Houston .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: He is in constant contact with Lydia Rodarte - Quayle , who tells him which containers she has taken off the manifests , which he sends to Golden Moth Chemical Company in Albuquerque , which in turn forwards them on to Lavanderia Brilliante and Gus 's lab .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Forenall is arrested after Hank and Gomez arrive at Madrigal 's warehouse in Houston and Lydia identifies him in the warehouse .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Forenall later appears as one of the nine incarcerated members of Gus 's organization who Lydia lists to be killed .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Forenall is last seen in a hallway when he is stabbed to death by the Neo-Nazis .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Barry Goodman

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Dr. Barry Goodman ( played by JB Blanc ) is Gus 's personal doctor , treating him and Mike after the showdown at Don Eladio 's residence .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: He later informs Mike about Gus 's death .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: He reappears in Better Call Saul as the doctor in a medical clinic for low - income Spanish - speaking patients .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Per Gus 's instructions , he provides Mike with cocaine to prepare a trap for Hector 's smugglers when they cross the border .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Tyrus Kitt Tyrus Kitt ( played by Ray Campbell ) is one of Gus 's henchmen in both Breaking Bad and Better Call Saul .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: He is Gus 's second in command at the beginning of Better Call Saul , until Mike Ehrmantraut supersedes him .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: In Breaking Bad , he takes Victor 's place , monitoring Walt and Jesse 's activities both inside and outside the lab , after Gus kills Victor .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Tyrus 's approach is calculating and pragmatic , in contrast to Victor 's reckless impulsivity .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: In the Breaking Bad episode " Face Off " Tyrus spots Hector Salamanca leaving the Albuquerque DEA office and assumes he has become an informant , which was part of Walt and Hector 's plan to lure Gus into a trap .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Gus and Tyrus visit Hector 's nursing home , where Gus prepares to kill Hector .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Hector has Walt 's pipe bomb attached to the bottom of his wheelchair , which he detonates with the front desk call bell he uses to communicate ; Hector , Tyrus , and Gus all die in the explosion .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Chris Mara Chris Mara ( played by Christopher King ) is one of Gus 's henchmen and frequently runs errands among Gus , the mules , and the dealers .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: One of his other jobs is to assist Tyrus Kitt in monitoring who enters and exits the Albuquerque Police Department and the DEA 's Albuquerque office .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Chris first appears in " Bug " , where he takes cover when Gaff opens fire on the operatives at the Los Pollos distribution center .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: He is later shown among the men looking for Walt when Walt goes into hiding .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Chris is watching from his car when Jesse exits the police station after being questioned about Brock Cantillo 's poisoning and later observes Hector Salamanca leave the DEA office after questioning .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: He also drives Gus to the retirement home so that Gus can kill Hector .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Chris later forces Duane Chow to call Mike and ask him to come to Duane 's house .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Mike sees Chris 's car in Duane 's driveway and senses a trap .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Mike creates a diversion for Chris with a toy on Duane 's front door , then sneaks in through the back door .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Chris confesses that because the DEA seized his cash , he accepted Lydia 's offer of $ 10,000 to kill each of the ten men on the " hit list " of Gus 's employees , and $ 30,000 for Mike .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Mike then kills Chris with a shot to the head , the same method Chris used to kill Duane .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Dennis Markowski Dennis Markowski ( played by Michael Batayeh ) manages Lavanderia Brilliante , the industrial laundromat that served as the cover for Gus 's superlab .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Following Gus 's death and the discovery of the lab , the DEA arrests Dennis and other members of Gus 's organization .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Dennis agrees to stay silent when Mike assures him he will continue to be paid .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: When Dennis 's cash is confiscated , he seeks a plea deal , but Hank refuses , believing he can obtain better information from others in Gus 's organization .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: To protect Walt 's identity , Walt arranges for Dennis and Gus 's other employees to be killed , and several inmates kill Dennis by pouring flammable liquid into his cell and igniting it .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Nick Nick ( played by Eric Steinig ) is a member of Gus' security team , under the management of Mike .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: He is shot in the head by Gaff when the latter attacks the Los Pollos Hermanos factory farm .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: His body is later dissolved in acid by Walter .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: In Better Call Saul , Nick takes part in many of the team 's operations , often alongside Mike and Gus' other men .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Rival Dealers The " Rival Dealers " ( played by Mike Seal and Antonio Leyba ) are two street - level drug dealers who work for Gus and sell meth on his behalf .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: They involved Tomás Cantillo in their activities , having him kill Combo as part of a gang initiation .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: After Gus decided to stop using Tomás for drug dealing , the two dealers killed the boy , leading to Jesse planning to kill them .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: After an attempt to poison the dealers fails , Jesse approaches the dealers for a final showdown and shootout , before Walter intervenes by running over the rival dealers with his car , killing one and severely injuring the other , whom Walt then shoots dead .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Peter Schuler

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Peter Schuler ( played by Norbert Weisser ) is the head of the fast food division of Madrigal Electromotive GmbH and a close associate of Gus and Lydia .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: He met Gus in Santiago , Chile , where they escaped a dangerous situation which marked the beginning of their friendship .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: He was hired by Mr. Herzog in 1992 at Madrigal .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: As head of the company 's fast food division , Schuler invested in Gus' restaurant chain Los Pollos Hermanos and assisted him in the business of his drug empire .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: In Better Call Saul , Schuler leads a meeting with the CEOs of Madrigal 's restaurant chains , where he reports Los Pollos Hermanos ' quarterly earnings .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: He later meets with Gus and Lydia in his room and panics about the delay in the construction of the superlab , fearing he will be caught funding for Gus ' drug operation .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Gus calms him down and reassures him the problems will be dealt with .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Following Gus ' death in Breaking Bad , Schuler 's connection with him is exposed .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: When the police arrive to question him , Schuler electrocutes himself with an automated external defibrillator .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Victor Victor ( played by Jeremiah Bitsui ) is Gus 's loyal henchman .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: He appears throughout Better Call Saul from season three onward with Gus 's introduction to the story , acting as Gus 's bodyguard and enforcer along with Tyrus , a role he maintains with Gus 's introduction in Breaking Bad .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Victor acts as Gus 's front in initial deals with Walter and Jesse .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: After Walter kills two of Gus 's dealers to protect Jesse , Victor takes a near - permanent position monitoring Walter 's activities while in the superlab with Gale .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Gus discovers Walter 's role in the dealers ' deaths , and orders Victor and Mike to bring Walter to the lab .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Walter makes a frantic call telling Jesse to kill Gale , believing this will motivate Gus to keep them alive .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Victor races to stop Jesse but arrives at Gale 's apartment too late .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Victor finds Jesse and brings him back to the lab , where he and Mike hold Jesse and Walter while waiting for Gus .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Walter tries to convince Gus that he needs Walt and Jesse to cook his meth , while Victor attempts to demonstrate that he has value to Gus by showing that he has learned how to cook by observing Walt .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Gus unexpectedly slices open Victor 's throat with a box cutter in front of Walter , Jesse , and Mike , then orders them to " get back to work " .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: They are forced to dispose of Victor 's body using hydrofluoric acid .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Though Mike commented that Gus may have killed Victor because he was seen at Gale 's apartment and can be connected to Gus , Walt later mentions to Jesse that he believes Gus did it because Victor took inappropriate liberties ( such as hastily cooking meth improperly while Mike held Walt and Jesse hostage , in an attempt to one - up them and expedite their deaths ) and " [ flew ] too close to the sun " , as Walt put it .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Dan Wachsberger Dan Wachsberger ( played by Chris Freihofer ) is an attorney hired by Mike Ehrmantraut to represent Ron Forenall , Dennis Markowski , and the other seven surviving members of Gus Fring 's operation running out of the Lavanderia Brilliante in Albuquerque .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Wachsberger takes the money ( Mike Ehrmantraut 's " legacy costs " ) from Mike and then deposits it to ten safety deposit boxes at the Cradock Marine Bank in Albuquerque : nine for Gus 's surviving men and their families to use in lieu of their " hazard pay " and one larger box for Mike 's granddaughter Kaylee on her 18th birthday .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Wachsberger first appears as he and Mike are going through the New Mexico Department of Corrections facility at Los Lunas south of Albuquerque .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Dan signs in and tells the attending guard , Darla , that he has brought in his " paralegal " and they have come to see Dennis Markowski .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Dan is consistently shown flirting with women , such as Darla and , at the bank , with Dorothy Yobs , whom he routinely lavishes with gifts of sugary baked goods .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Dorothy gives Dan access to the safety deposit boxes at Cradock Marine Bank .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Eventually , Hank and Gomez discover Mike and Dan 's transactions and their safety deposit boxes at Cradock Marine Bank , and Gomez is sent to investigate .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Gomez and his agents discover Dan making his routine drops in these boxes , arrest him , and successfully induce Dan to inform on Mike .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: The last time Wachsberger appears , he is in the Federal Correctional Institution , La Tuna when Wachsberger is stabbed to death at the same time the nine surviving members of Gus 's operation are also killed , which Walt ordered to conceal his connection to Gus .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Los Pollos Hermanos

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Cynthia Cynthia ( portrayed by Ashley Kajiki ) is the manager of the Los Pollos Hermanos restaurant chain 's Albuquerque store .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: She occasionally encounters Walter when he demands to meet with Gus .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Lyle Lyle ( portrayed by Harrison Thomas ) is the assistant manager of the Los Pollos Hermanos in Albuquerque .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: He is loyal to Gus and takes great pride in his work , but is oblivious to Gus 's role in the illegal drug trade .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Lyle is temporarily promoted to store manager while Gus recovers after he is wounded in the shootout with Lalo and tells Lyle he is unable to come into work due to a family emergency .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Werner Ziegler 's construction team

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Werner Ziegler

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Werner Ziegler ( played by Rainer Bock ) is a German construction engineer hired by Gus to build his underground methamphetamine laboratory .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: After vetting by Mike , Gus chooses Werner over an overly confident French engineer because of Werner 's frank explanation of the difficulties involved in the construction .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: When Gus and Mike hire Werner to supervise construction of a meth lab under Gus 's industrial laundry , Werner employs several other laborers .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: When it becomes clear the job will take longer than anticipated and tempers flare among Werner 's crew , Mike arranges an " R&R " outing to a strip club .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Mike and Werner retire to a quiet bar for a personal conversation , but Mike has to return to the strip club to smooth over an altercation , and during his absence Werner drunkenly reveals construction details to other patrons at the bar .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Werner later requests a weekend off to visit with his wife , which Mike denies .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Werner then escapes by bypassing the security system where his crew and he are quartered .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: According to the note he left behind , he plans to visit with his wife and then return to finish the work .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Mike tracks Werner down at a local spa , but so does Lalo Salamanca , to whom Werner mistakenly reveals construction details before Mike ends the call .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Mike asks Gus to let Werner return to work , but Gus understands that through Werner , Lalo could learn the secret of the meth lab 's construction , so he says he will send men to kill Werner .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Mike says he will do it himself and convinces Werner to contact his wife at the airport and send her home .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: He promises that Werner 's death will have an explanation that satisfies the authorities , so that his wife will not wonder what happened to him , and to return Werner 's crew to Germany unharmed .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Werner tells Mike he wants to take a last walk to look at the stars , and Mike follows and shoots him in the head .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Casper ( portrayed by Stefan Kapičić ) is a member of Werner Ziegler 's construction crew .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: As Mike hands out plane tickets to each of the crew members , Casper confronts him and says that Werner " was worth 50 of you . "

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Werner 's widow Margarethe believes Werner died in a cave - in , during which he saved his crew .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: The crew , whom Werner called " my boys " , did not attend his funeral , but sent a Lucite sculpture which contained Werner 's slide rule and an inscription indicating the gift was from " Your Boys " .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Under an alias , Lalo converses with Margarethe and learns of the " my boys " expression .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: When he breaks into Margarethe 's house the next day , he finds the sculpture , which contains a manufacturer 's label .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: This clue leads Lalo to Casper , and he soon arrives at Casper 's remote home .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: In the ensuing confrontation , Casper strikes Lalo with the blunt side of an axe , but Lalo slashes Casper 's face with a hidden razor blade , then uses the axe to sever his foot .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Lalo gives Casper his belt for use as a tourniquet , then interrogates him about his work with Werner .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Kai Kai ( played by Ben Bela Böhm ) is a member of Werner Ziegler 's construction crew .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: He is insolent , rebellious and belligerent .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Werner keeps him in his employ because Kai is his best demolition man , though Kai often causes trouble for the team ; on one occasion , Kai starts a fight with Casper over a blunder by the latter , and on another occasion he is thrown out of a nightclub for drunkenly inappropriately touching a stripper .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: After Werner 's death at the hands of Mike , Gus pays the construction crew and returns them to Europe .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: As Mike gives the crew their plane tickets , Kai rationalizes Mike 's killing of Werner , to which Mike angrily punches Kai in the face before he leaves for Germany .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Mexican drug cartel

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Eladio Vuente

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Don Eladio Vuente ( played by Steven Bauer ) is the head of a drug cartel in Ciudad Juárez that includes Juan Bolsa , Hector Salamanca , and Salamanca 's nephews .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: He first met Gus Fring twenty years prior to the start of the series , when Gus and his partner Max proposed producing methamphetamine for the cartel .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Unimpressed by their pitch , Eladio declined because the cartel preferred to continue distributing cocaine .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: After the meeting , Eladio had Hector execute Max as retaliation for manipulating him into a meeting , but spared Gus 's life due to an unrevealed but powerful connection to Chile .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: He then forced Gus to work with the cartel under Eladio 's terms , and Gus became the cartel 's chief distributor in the American Southwest .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Following the deaths of Juan Bolsa and the Cousins , and Gus 's subsequent establishment of the meth superlab , Eladio orders retribution , and his henchman Gaff hijacks meth deliveries and kills some of Gus 's operatives .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Gus agrees to Eladio 's demands — the formula for the blue meth , the services of a chemist , and a 50 percent share of the business — and travels to the cartel 's superlab with Mike and Jesse .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: After Jesse cooks a batch , Eladio invites them to a party at his villa attended by his capos , who toast their new business venture with a bottle of Zafiro Añejo premium tequila supplied by Gus.

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Eladio chides Gus as someone who provides value to the organization , but periodically needs to be reminded of his place .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: The capos begin to collapse shortly after the toast , victims of the poison Gus put in the tequila .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Gus had previously built up a tolerance to the poison , and intentionally vomited soon after the toast .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Eladio realizes that Gus has betrayed him and attempts to lunge at him , but collapses dead into the swimming pool .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Eladio first appears in Better Call Saul through a Season 3 flashback ( " Sabrosito " ) in which he teases Hector because his cash tribute and gifts are inferior to Gus 's .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: In season 5 ( " Something Unforgivable " ) , Eladio meets with Lalo and Nacho and gives his blessing to the Salamancas ' plan for Nacho to manage their organization while Lalo hides from police and prosecutors in Mexico .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Following Lalo 's death in Season 6 ( " Fun and Games " ) , Hector reveals to Eladio that Lalo survived Gus 's first attempt to kill him and accuses Gus of having recently killed him .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: With no evidence that Lalo survived the first attempt , Eladio dismisses Hector 's accusations and sends him to bed .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: To maintain the peace , Eladio splits up the Albuquerque drug territory between Gus and Hector .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: He recognizes that Gus hates him which he says is fine as long as Gus remembers " who 's boss " .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Juan Bolsa Juan Bolsa ( played by Javier Grajeda ) is a high - level member of the Mexican drug cartel to which the Salamanca family and Gus belong .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Within Better Call Saul he generally acts as the voice of the cartel to mediate issues between the Salamancas and Gustavo Fring because he wants to make sure both earn profits for the cartel .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Bolsa sometimes secretly works with one side or the other for his own benefit .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: When Mike secretly disrupts the Salamancas ' trucking route for smuggling drugs from Mexico , Bolsa orders that Salamanca drugs will be transported by Gus 's trucks , a result Gus worked with Mike to produce because it gave Gus more power over the Salamancas .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Bolsa intercedes when Gus provides a false story about Werner Ziegler 's activities and death , telling Lalo Salamanca that Gus enjoys Don Eladio 's trust , so Lalo should consider the matter closed .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: When Lalo is seeking to arrange for Jimmy McGill to pick up his bail money , Bolsa discreetly arranges for a squad of gunmen to attack Jimmy , believing that keeping Lalo in prison is in Gus 's best interests but unaware that Gus had his own plans .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Bolsa later oversees the cartel 's manhunt for Nacho Varga after Nacho aids in an assassination attempt on Lalo .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Nacho surrenders to the cartel and falsely claims to be a mole for a rival gang ( rather than Gus ) in order to protect his father .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: He then rebukes the Salamancas , reveals himself responsible for Hector 's stroke , then kills himself with Bolsa 's gun .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Later , Bolsa takes part in a meeting with the Salamancas and Don Eladio where Hector accuses Gus of setting up the attempt on Lalo 's life and later killing him .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: However , Don Eladio does not believe it and Bolsa is visibly relieved by the conclusion of the matter .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Within Breaking Bad , it is Bolsa who orders Tortuga 's execution by The Cousins and later places his head on a booby - trapped tortoise for the DEA to find .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: He is also the cartel 's liaison with Gus , and the one who arranges a meeting among Gus , the Cousins , and Hector to determine how to handle Walter following Tuco 's death .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Bolsa tells

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Gus he will urge the Salamanca family to be patient but advises that Gus risks losing favor with the cartel if he does not finish his business with Walter quickly .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: He goes on to say that he can not guarantee the Cousins will listen to reason and leave Walter alive until his business with Gus is done .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: He has forbidden the Cousins to kill Hank in retaliation for Hank 's killing of Tuco because killing law enforcement officers will bring on more police scrutiny .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Gus secretly sanctions an attack on Hank instead of Walter , resulting in severe injuries to Hank and the deaths of The Cousins .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Bolsa meets his end when Gus secretly tips off Mexican federales in Ciudad Juárez , who kill Bolsa as retaliation for The Cousins ' attack on Hank .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Bolsa 's name , translated literally from Spanish , is John Bag or John Sack ; this is a nod to the character John " Johnny Sack " Sacrimoni from the HBO drama The Sopranos .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Both characters are high - ranking members of powerful crime families who are very level - headed , well - spoken , and act as intermediaries between their families and others .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Héctor Salamanca Héctor Salamanca ( played by Mark Margolis ) , often known as " Don Héctor " or " Tío " , is the elderly don of the Salamanca drug organization and an associate of cartel boss Don Eladio .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: He is the uncle of twins Leonel and Marco Salamanca ( the Cousins ) , Tuco Salamanca , and Lalo Salamanca , and raised Tuco as a son .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: He taught his nephews that family is everything and lives by the creed himself .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Though brutal , Hector is very loyal .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: He spent 17 years in San Quentin State Prison but never revealed any information to the authorities .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: In an extended flashback in the Breaking Bad episode " Hermanos " , Hector is shown to be responsible for the death of Max Arciniega , Gus Fring 's partner , whom Don Eladio ordered killed after he was insulted by Gus and Max 's offer to produce meth for the cartel , which preferred to keep distributing cocaine .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Gus loathes Hector , who in turn resents and degrades Gus , calling him " chicken man " ( hombre gallina in Spanish , literally " hen man " ) and a " dirty " South American .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Despite their mutual hatred , Hector and Gus are forced to cooperate since each is based in Albuquerque , though each frequently schemes to displace the other .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Hector is the boss of the Salamanca family at the start of Better Call Saul .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: After Mike Ehrmantraut and Nacho Varga arrange for Tuco 's imprisonment by provoking him into attacking Mike , Hector offers Mike $ 5,000 to reduce Tuco 's sentence by claiming the gun Tuco was carrying was Mike 's .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Hector tries to intimidate Mike into accepting , and Mike eventually accepts $ 50,000 .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Mike is concerned about Hector 's threats to Stacey and Kaylee and retaliates by attacking a truck transporting Hector 's drug cash .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Hector kills a witness who stopped to aid the driver , Ximenez , and later has Leonel and Marco bury the witness in the desert .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: While Hector and the Cousins are preparing to kill Ximenez , Mike attempts to shoot Hector with a sniper rifle , but is stopped by someone unseen , who sets off his car horn and leaves a note warning him not to do it .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: In season 3 , Mike learns it was Gus who tracked his location and warned him against killing Hector ; Gus intends to be the agent of Hector 's demise when the time is right .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Mike 's and Gus 's machinations force Hector to find a new way to ship his product from Mexico and he decides to use the upholstery store owned by Nacho 's father Manuel .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Nacho tries to induce a heart attack by switching Hector 's heart medication capsules for fakes containing ibuprofen .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Hector has a stroke while meeting with Gus and Juan Bolsa but Gus saves him with CPR .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: In season 4 , Hector is comatose and Gus arranges for a specialist from Johns Hopkins to oversee his care .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Over the next few months , her therapy restores Hector 's mental faculties , but he is unable to speak and is immobile except for his right index finger .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Gus has the specialist discontinue treatment , trapping Hector 's sound mind in his unhealed body , and Hector relies on a wheelchair for the rest of his life .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Leonel and Marco Salamanca ( played by Daniel and Luis Moncada respectively ) , referred to as " The Cousins " or " The Twins " , are twin brothers and prolific hitmen for Don Eladio 's drug cartel .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: As children , the Cousins were raised by their uncle Hector Salamanca along with their cousin Tuco .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Hector once tested them when he stopped a boyhood fight by nearly drowning Marco , which forced Leonel to hit Hector to make him release his grip .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: After Marco caught his breath , Hector reinforced the lesson that " family is all . "

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: By the time of events in Better Call Saul and Breaking Bad , they have become deadly enforcers .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Their austere , mechanical physicality and virtually non-verbal interaction makes them a fearsome presence , and they kill without hesitation or emotion .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: In Better Call Saul , the Cousins serve as Hector 's enforcers .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: When Hector has a stroke as a result of taking placebo medication that Nacho had planted instead of his nitroglycerin pills for his heart condition , the Cousins quickly arrive to watch over Hector at the hospital and refuse to leave his side .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Gus , who has a vested interest in deciding Hector 's fate as revenge for Max , arranges for a skilled therapist fluent in Spanish to see to Hector 's recovery and explain his health to the Cousins .

text: Gus learns what Nacho did with the pills and forces him to become his mole by murdering Arturo in front of him .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: As their activities have drawn police attention , the Cousins return to Mexico .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: This gives Gus the opportunity to dismiss the therapist and leave Hector in a state where he can only move his eyes and his right index finger .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: While mixing chemicals , Walter creates a small explosion that produces phosphine gas , which appears to kill both Emilio and Krazy - 8. Emilio dies , but Krazy - 8 regains consciousness , prompting Jesse and Walt to imprison him in Jesse 's basement for several days as they ponder what to do with him .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Walt begins to bond with Krazy - 8 , feeding him and sharing beers ; Krazy - 8 is the first person Walt tells about his cancer .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Walt is nearly convinced to free him , but realizes that Krazy - 8 plans to attack him with a concealed piece of broken Fiestaware , and strangles him to death .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Later , in episode 7 of the season , it is implied that Walter disposed of Krazy - 8 's body with hydrofluoric acid in the same manner as Emilio 's , when Jesse states that two bodies had been flushed down the house 's toilet .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: From that point on , throughout the series , Walt makes sandwiches without bread crusts , adopting Krazy - 8 's manner of eating sandwiches .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Following the discovery of his car in the desert , it is revealed by Hank Schrader and Steven Gomez that Krazy - 8 is actually the informant who had led them to Emilio and Jesse 's lab in the first place during the ride - along that had triggered Walt 's interest in the drug trade .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: The discovery of a sample of Walt 's meth hidden in Krazy - 8 's car alerts them to the existence of new players in town .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: In season two , Hank states that Tuco Salamanca is suspected of murdering Krazy - 8 , but Gomez states that they could not prove it .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Krazy - 8 also appears in Better Call Saul as part of the Salamanca drug ring .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Initially one of the dealers , he takes on a lieutenant role under Nacho after Hector Salamanca has a stroke and becomes paralyzed , and continues in this position when Lalo Salamanca arrives from Mexico to oversee operations .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Lalo is the one to nickname Domingo " Ocho Loco " ( Spanish for " Crazy Eight " ) based on his misplaying of a hand during a poker game .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Krazy - 8 is arrested when one of the Salamanca drug houses is discovered by the local police , leading Nacho to seek Jimmy McGill 's legal services to help free him .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Jimmy , as Saul Goodman , creates a ploy that draws Hank to see Domingo , and through Saul 's machinations , secures Domingo 's release by assuring that he will be Hank 's confidential informant .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Lalo subsequently uses Krazy - 8 to sabotage Gus Fring 's rival drug operations until Mike gets Lalo arrested for murder .

text: Aryan Brotherhood

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Jack Welker Jack Welker ( played by Michael Bowen ) is Todd Alquist 's uncle and the leader of a Neo-Nazi gang .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Walter pays Jack to kill Mike 's crew after they are arrested , because Walt fears they can identify him as a member of Gus 's operation and may enter into plea bargains as government informants since the DEA has stopped the payments Gus had arranged for their families .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Jack 's gang kills nine of Mike 's men and their lawyer Dan Wachsberger in three prisons , within two minutes , which prevents any of them from warning the others or law enforcement authorities from adding extra protection .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Jack also heads his gang 's massacre of Declan 's at Lydia 's behest after Declan refuses Lydia 's request to replace his shoddy meth cook with Todd .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Jack and his crew are later hired by Walt to kill Jesse in exchange for teaching Todd to cook meth one more time .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: When Walt is lured to the money 's location by Jesse , he calls Jack 's crew for help , but calls it off when he sees Hank and Gomez are with Jesse .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Nonetheless , Jack and his crew arrive and engage in a shootout with Hank and Gomez .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Following the shootout , in which Gomez is killed , Jack murders Hank and abducts Jesse ( initially to kill him , then to force him to work as an enslaved meth cook ) .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Jack then orders the gang to dig up Walt 's barrels of money ( containing approximately $ 80 million ) , but at Todd 's behest he leaves Walt alive with one barrel ( about $ 11 million ) .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Several months later , Walt arrives at Jack 's hideout and remotely activates an M60 machine gun hidden in his car 's trunk ; the massive bullet spray kills Jack 's entire gang except for Jack and Todd .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: An enraged Jesse strangles Todd with the chain that connects his shackles .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: A mortally wounded Jack offers to trade the money he took from Walt for his life , but Walt coldly shoots him in mid-sentence , in the same manner that Jack shot Hank .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Kenny ( Kevin Rankin ) is Jack 's protégé and second - in - command , and the Brotherhood 's tech expert .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Kenny is one of the gang members killed in Walter White 's M60 machine gun attack .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: He also appears in El Camino : A Breaking Bad Movie , in which he is seen in a flashback as he taunts Jesse during Neil Kandy 's construction of the tether that restrains Jesse while he is forced to cook meth for the Brotherhood .
