text: Andrea Cantillo

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Andrea Cantillo ( played by Emily Rios ) is a love interest of Jesse Pinkman 's .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: She is a recovering meth addict and single mother to a young son named Brock ( played by Ian Posada ) .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Jesse meets her at a drug addicts ' support group meeting and initially tries to get her to relapse so she will become a customer of his , but he reverses course when he learns she has a young son to care for .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: He engages in a romantic relationship with her , but ends it when he discovers that the 11 - year - old boy who killed his friend " Combo " is her younger brother Tomas Cantillo ( played by Angelo Martinez ) .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: After the break - up , she confronts Jesse at his home about a large sum of money he had left for her at her home .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: He tells her the money is for her to move out of her bad neighborhood and to help raise her son .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Saul continues to deliver money to her , in her new home , on Jesse 's behalf .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: In Season 4 , she and Jesse reunite .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: When Brock is poisoned , Jesse rushes to the hospital and stays there until the doctors notify him that Brock will survive .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: In Season 5 , Walt manipulates Jesse into leaving her , by advising Jesse that he would have to be honest with her about all the crimes he has committed .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: While Jesse does send them off again , he continues providing for them financially .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Later in the season , Andrea is again contacted by Walt in a failed attempt to lure Jesse out of DEA protection .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Walter assigns Jack to watch over the house in case Jesse makes an appearance .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Subsequently , Jack uses her as leverage against Jesse , who is kept prisoner by him and his team to cook meth for them .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: After Jesse attempts to escape from Jack 's gang , Todd shoots and kills Andrea while Jesse is forced to watch .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Brock Cantillo Brock Cantillo ( played by Ian Posada ) is Andrea 's seven - year - old son .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Andrea is a recovering meth addict and single mother .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Jesse meets her at a drug addicts ' twelve - step program meeting and initially tries to get her to relapse , so she will become his customer , but he reverses course when he meets Brock and realizes she has a young son to care for .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Jesse engages in a romantic relationship with Andrea , but ends it when he discovers that the 11 - year - old boy who killed his friend " Combo " is her younger brother Tomas Cantillo ( played by Angelo Martinez ) ; however , Jesse continues to offer financial support to Andrea and Brock .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: In Season 4 , Andrea and Jesse reunite .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: When Brock gets sick , Jesse rushes to the hospital , and warns the doctors about a possible ricin poisoning , then stays there until the doctors notify him that Brock will survive ( it turns out that the boy was indeed poisoned , although not with ricin but with lily of the valley ; still , this timely warning put them on the right track ) .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Jesse fears Brock was poisoned by a ricin cigarette Jesse was carrying .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Walt tries to convince Jesse that Gus poisoned Brock .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: This manipulation by Walt renews Jesse 's loyalty to him rather than to Gus .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: In the final season 's episode " Confessions " Jesse suddenly changes his mind about leaving town and assuming a new identity when he realizes Walt poisoned Brock .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Jesse then rushes to Walt 's house and attempts to burn it down , but is intercepted by Hank .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Subsequently , Brock and Andrea are used as leverage against Jesse , who is kept prisoner by Todd and Jack 's gang to cook meth for them .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: After Jesse attempts to escape , Todd shoots and kills Andrea while Jesse is forced to watch ; Jesse is threatened with Brock 's death if he attempts to escape again .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: In El Camino : A Breaking Bad Movie , Jesse prepares to leave for a new life in Alaska and gives Ed a letter for Brock , who is the only person to whom he wants to say goodbye .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: After reading it , Ed promises to mail it from Mexico City the following month , ensuring that Brock will get it and that it can not be traced to Jesse in Alaska .

text: Jane Margolis

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Jane Margolis ( played by Krysten Ritter ) is Jesse 's landlady , neighbor , and eventual girlfriend .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: She is a prolific drafter , a skill that she has used to become a tattoo artist despite not having any tattoos .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: She is also a recovering drug addict .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: She discovers that Jesse also has a past interest in drawing , and they become intrigued by each other .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: They quickly become a couple , and she relapses into drug addiction , introducing Jesse to heroin .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: She later phones Walt and successfully threatens to expose him if he refuses to give Jesse his share of money from a major methamphetamine deal with Gus Fring , a deal that Jesse 's drug use had nearly ruined .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: After Walt drops off Jesse 's cut of nearly half a million dollars at his duplex , she and Jesse discuss running away together to New Zealand to start new lives .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: They go into Jesse 's bedroom and see the heroin , but instead of throwing it away as they had promised themselves earlier , they get high and fall asleep .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: That night , Walt returns to the apartment and finds the drugged - out couple unconscious in bed .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: In the process of trying to wake Jesse from his stupor , Walt accidentally turns Jane onto her back .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: She begins to vomit while asleep , and Walt silently stands at the bedside watching her choke and then asphyxiate to death .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Series creator Vince Gilligan explained Walt 's motive for allowing Jane to die during a 2013 panel discussion about Breaking Bad at the Film at Lincoln Center , stating that Walt was afraid Jane 's bad influence would lead Jesse to an early death from a heroin overdose .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Jane 's death leads to significant repercussions throughout the rest of the series , and is largely responsible for Jesse 's downward spiral in the first half of the third season , as well as her father Donald 's deep depression which affects him to the point that he fails in his duties as an air - traffic controller and causes a midair collision between a 737 and a King Air 350 ( " ABQ " ) .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: In the episode " Fly " , while under the influence of sleeping pills , Walt is tormented by his guilt over his inaction the night of Jane 's death ; he reveals to Jesse that on the same night she died , he unknowingly met her father in a bar ( realizing it was him only after seeing him on the news following the plane crash ) , and questions the statistical improbability of that sequence of events , but stops shy of revealing his involvement .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Walt finally reveals the full extent of his role in Jane 's death to Jesse in the series ' ante - penultimate episode , " Ozymandias " , as a final blow after he ordered Jack to kill him , deeming him responsible for Hank 's death and the loss of his fortune .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Jane appears in a flashback in El Camino : A Breaking Bad Movie , reciting the final lines of the film .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: She reminds Jesse that sometimes the universe takes people towards bad places , and despite her free - spirited nature she considers it better to make life 's important decisions by yourself .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Badger Brandon " Badger " Mayhew ( played by Matt L. Jones ) is Jesse 's friend .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Despite being on probation , Badger still uses drugs .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: He had a job as a street advertising mascot for an Albuquerque bank .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: During Season 1 , Badger leaves the job to cook crystal meth with Jesse .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Disagreements soon occur and they bitterly part ways .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: In Season 2 , Badger and Jesse reconcile , and Badger helps clear the meth lab from Jesse 's basement , then assists in hiding Jesse 's RV , which previously contained the meth lab .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Walt and Jesse later employ Badger to sell their product , but he is quickly arrested .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Once released , Badger flees to California .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: After Badger returns to New Mexico , Jesse persuades him to start selling meth again .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Badger later attends Narcotics Anonymous meetings with Skinny Pete , where they intend to find new buyers by informing a group of recovering drug addicts that " Blue Sky " ( Walt and Jesse 's product ) is again available .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Badger and Pete begin to find the meetings helpful and continue to attend regularly .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Badger helps Jesse several more times , and is in attendance at Jesse 's house party , which lasts several days .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: He is also the lead singer for TwaüghtHammër , the band in which he plays with Jesse .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Badger is a science fiction fan and discusses at length his idea for a Star Trek script in the episode " Blood Money . "

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: He and Pete help Walt threaten the Schwartzes in the series finale , " Felina " , by holding laser pointers to imitate the laser sights of sniper rifles .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: The ruse enables Walt to compel the Schwartzes to use Walt 's remaining money to establish a trust for Walter Jr. Badger and Skinny Pete appear in El Camino , helping Jesse hide for the night after he flees Jack 's compound in Todd 's El Camino and distracting police to give Jesse time to get away .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: As part of Pete 's plan to aid Jesse , Pete stays at home and waits for police to respond to the El Camino 's LoJack so he can tell them he traded his Thunderbird to Jesse for the El Camino .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Badger drives Pete 's Thunderbird several hours south of Albuquerque to make it appear that Jesse fled to Mexico .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Jesse leaves Badger and Pete 's house in Badger 's Pontiac Fiero .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: After saying goodbye to Badger and Pete , Jesse continues to drive Badger 's Fiero until he leaves Albuquerque with Ed to start his new life in Alaska .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: As later revealed by Francesca Liddy in Better Call Saul 's " Breaking Bad " , Skinny Pete and Badger 's plan worked and the authorities later found the car by the Mexico border and as a result , they believe that Jesse has fled to Mexico .

text: Skinny Pete

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: He served time in prison with Tuco and introduces Jesse to him .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Jesse recruits Pete to deal meth , although Pete is on probation .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: When Pete is mugged by two addicts , Jesse is forced to get the money and product back .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: After Badger is arrested and Combo is killed , Pete quits dealing for Jesse , fearing being sent back to prison and for his own safety .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: He decides to sell meth for Jesse again , albeit on a smaller scale .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: He attends Narcotics Anonymous meetings with Badger .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: After following the program together and staying clean , they relapse when Jesse tempts them with meth .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: After a few days of heavy meth use they leave Jesse 's house .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: In the Season 5 episode " Hazard Pay " , Pete is shown to be a talented pianist as he plays a small section of C.P.E. Bach 's Solfeggietto at a music store .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: He is also seen in the mid-season premiere " Blood Money " , hanging out at Jesse 's house and listening to Badger 's Star Trek script .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Pete is seen briefly in the series finale , when Walt compels Gretchen and Elliot to use his remaining money to establish a trust for Walter Jr. and Badger and Pete to use laser pointers to make them believe hitmen will kill them if they do not comply .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Pete and Badger also inform Walt that his trademark blue meth is still circulating , which Walt realizes means Jesse is still alive .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: The following morning , Pete devises a plan to help Jesse evade police .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Badger and Pete give Jesse the money Walt paid them for their role in coercing Gretchen and Elliot .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Badger drives Pete 's Thunderbird several hours south to make it appear Jesse fled to Mexico .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Jesse departs Pete and Badger 's house in Badger 's Pontiac Fiero .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Combo Christian " Combo " Ortega ( played by Rodney Rush ) is Jesse 's friend and a dealer of his methamphetamine .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: He is also revealed to have been the one who originally owned the RV that Walt and Jesse cooked meth in , which Combo had sold to Jesse for $ 1,400 without his family 's knowledge , which provides a big clue for Hank when tracking down " Heisenberg " .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: He once got in legal trouble as a juvenile for stealing a Baby Jesus from a Nativity display , but was helped by Kim Wexler who served as his public defender .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Combo is later killed in " Mandala " when a rival drug group corners him while he is dealing methamphetamine on " foreign turf . "

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Combo calls his friend Skinny Pete to report two men are " mad eyeballing " him .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: As he hangs up the phone , a kid on a bicycle shoots him several times , killing him on the street .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Combo 's death drives Jesse to spiral into drug addiction .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Jesse eventually learns that the kid is Tomas Cantillo , the little brother of his new girlfriend Andrea and that Combo was murdered as part of a gang initiation .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Jesse subsequently seeks retribution upon the dealers for Combo 's murder and the murder of Tomas , putting him at odds with Gus Fring .

text: Adam and Diane Pinkman Adam Pinkman ( played by Michael Bofshever ) and Diane Pinkman ( played by Tess Harper ) are Jesse Pinkman 's parents .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Due to Jesse 's drug abuse , they have a strained relationship with their son , kicking him out of his late aunt 's house ( where Jesse had been living after serving as his aunt 's caretaker and friend ) after discovering a makeshift meth lab in the basement , believing it to be for manufacturing speed .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Adam and Diane renovate the home , preparing it for sale .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Unbeknownst to them , Jesse works with Saul Goodman to reacquire the home .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Claiming to represent an anonymous buyer , Saul presents an offer significantly under market value .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Offended , the Pinkmans begin to leave the negotiating table .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: As they are leaving , Saul reveals he knows the home used to host a meth lab , which is not revealed as required in the property disclosures ; he then informs them that not declaring this is an illegal act .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Realizing that the home price will plummet and they may be sued , Adam and Diane Pinkman reluctantly accept Saul 's offer .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: On the closing date , Jesse visits his parents at the newly renovated home .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: When Jesse heads to the front door , Diane tells Jesse that the house has been sold , and that he needs to leave , as the new owners will be stopping by shortly .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: When Jesse does not stop , a confused Mrs. Pinkman asks where he is going .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Jesse reveals that he is the new owner .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: The Pinkmans appear in El Camino , requesting in a news interview that Jesse turn himself in .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: After his parents leave , Jesse 's call is revealed to be a ruse to draw them and police away from the house .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Jesse enters unobserved and recovers two handguns from his parents ' safe , a Colt Woodsman and an Iver Johnson Hammerless .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Jesse accepts the blame for a joint belonging to Jake , which results in Jesse being thrown out of his parents ' house .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: After apologizing to his brother , Jake asks for his joint back ; Jesse responds by crushing it on the sidewalk and informing his brother that the marijuana is of poor quality anyway .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: In El Camino , when Jesse calls his parents he asks about Jake , and they tell Jesse that Jake is attending a band camp in London , implying that they are yet to find out about his addiction .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: When Jesse attempts to open his parents ' safe , he correctly guesses that the combination corresponds to Jake 's birthday .

text: Wendy Wendy ( portrayed by Julia Minesci ) is a meth - addicted street prostitute , who associates with Jesse Pinkman and is featured in the online promotional material as one of Saul Goodman 's clients ( as " Wendy S. " ) .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: In Better Call Saul ( " Hit and Run " ) , Jimmy and Kim hire her to help run a con against Howard Hamlin .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Wendy alerts Kim to a car following them , which Wendy believes to be undercover police ; Kim later discovers that she and Jimmy are being monitored as part of Mike and Gus 's manhunt for Lalo Salamanca .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: In Breaking Bad Wendy helps Jesse maintain an alibi and withstands an intense interrogation from Hank Schrader on Jesse 's behalf .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Recognizing her loyalty to him , Jesse tries to convince her to help him kill two drug dealers who convinced Tomás to murder Combo on Gus 's orders .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: She declines at first , fearing the repercussions , revealing that she has a son whom she needs to protect , but Jesse persuades her to help by drawing a comparison between Tomás and her own son .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: At the last moment , she is spared the ordeal by Mike , who intervenes to take Jesse to a meeting with the drug dealers .

text: Marco Pasternak

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Marco Pasternak ( portrayed by Mel Rodriguez ) is a scam artist and one of Jimmy McGill 's lifelong friends .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: A high school classmate of Jimmy 's in Cicero , Illinois , they frequently worked cons together , including the " fake Rolex " .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: After Chuck helps secure Jimmy 's release following his arrest for the " Chicago sunroof " incident , Chuck requires Jimmy to move to Albuquerque and work a legitimate job .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Jimmy stops by his and Marco 's favorite bar to say goodbye , leaving Marco disappointed .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: After suffering a breakdown because of Chuck 's attempts to prevent him from rising in the legal profession , Jimmy returns to Cicero and reunites with Marco , who now works for his brother - in - law as a standpipe installer .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: After a week of running successful scams , Jimmy informs Marco he is an attorney and needs to return to Albuquerque .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Marco begs Jimmy to pull one more scam before he goes , and Jimmy agrees .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: While running the " fake Rolex " con , Marco suffers a fatal heart attack .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Before he dies , he tells Jimmy that the week they spent together was the best of his life .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Jimmy inherits Marco 's pinky ring , which is too big for him .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Despite the poor fit , Jimmy begins to wear Marco 's ring as a symbol of his newfound willingness to cut corners to get ahead in the legal profession .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Ernesto Ernesto ( portrayed by Brandon K. Hampton ) is an employee of HHM and a friend of Jimmy McGill and Kim Wexler .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: After Chuck McGill told Jimmy that he disapproved of his legal career and did not view him as a peer , Jimmy asked Howard to ensure Chuck continued to be looked after , including bringing him groceries and newspapers .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Howard assigned Chuck 's daily care to Ernesto .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: After Chuck suspects Jimmy of altering Mesa Verde documents to regain the bank as a client for Kim , he enlists Ernesto to investigate , and Ernesto eventually finds the all - night copy store where Jimmy carried out the alterations .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Ernesto brings Chuck to the store to interview the clerk but Chuck 's EHS symptoms cause him to faint and hit his head on a counter .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Jimmy was hiding nearby after bribing the clerk to deny having seen him on his earlier visit , and enters the store to provide first aid to Chuck .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: At the hospital , Chuck wonders how Jimmy happened on the scene so quickly .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Ernesto covers for Jimmy by claiming that out of concern for Chuck 's health , he called Jimmy after identifying the store but before bringing Chuck to the location .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: As part of his plot to get Jimmy disbarred , Chuck manipulates Ernesto into hearing part of Jimmy 's recorded confession to altering the Mesa Verde documents , assuming that even though Chuck has sworn him to silence , Ernesto ’s loyalty and friendship will compel him to inform Kim and Jimmy .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Ernesto informs Kim , who in turn informs Jimmy .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: After Jimmy angrily breaks into Chuck 's house to destroy the tape and is witnessed by Howard and a private investigator , which enables Chuck to have Jimmy prosecuted , HHM coldly fires Ernesto for disclosing confidential information even though their scheme could not have succeeded without Ernesto having done the specific thing Chuck manipulated Ernesto into doing .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Francesca Liddy Francesca Liddy ( played by Tina Parker ) is Saul Goodman 's outspoken receptionist and secretary .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Originally employed at the New Mexico Motor Vehicle Division , Jimmy hired her for the Wexler - McGill law firm .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: After Kim 's car accident , Jimmy and Kim closed their office , and Francesca returned to the MVD .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: When Jimmy started practicing as Saul Goodman , Francesca returned to work for him .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: In " Quite a Ride " , a flashforward to 2010 shows Saul and Francesca frantically clearing out his office .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: She agrees to be at a telephone booth on November 12 ( Jimmy 's birthday ) at 3 p.m. to receive a call .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: He gives her money and an attorney 's business card and tells her that if she needs help she should say " Jimmy " sent her .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: As she leaves , Saul claims the last few years have been " quite a ride " , then calls Ed Galbraith for a new identity .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: In the Better Call Saul episode " Breaking Bad " , in a flashforward , Francesca is now an apartment building manager and she answers the prearranged phone call which proves to be from Saul himself .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: After getting paid via money that Saul had left behind for her , Francesca reveals that the DEA had found and seized all of Saul 's hidden assets .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: With Walt dead and Jesse Pinkman having supposedly fled the country , Saul is now their sole target .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: At Saul 's request , Francesca tells him about what became of Skyler White and Huell Babineaux before revealing that Kim had called her asking after Saul .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Huell Babineaux

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Huell Babineaux ( played by Lavell Crawford ) is Saul Goodman 's bodyguard , who also executes various intimidation tactics and performs other errands .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Hired more for his size , strength , and pickpocketing skills than his intelligence , he has a condition approximating narcolepsy ( e.g. , he falls asleep at odd times , such as when standing up or while on security detail ) , and has digestive problems that keep him from being as stoic as Saul would like .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: During the bar association hearing considering Jimmy McGill 's disbarment over his break in at Chuck 's house , he hires Huell to plant a cell phone battery in his brother Chuck 's pocket as part of a strategy to discredit Chuck 's claimed electromagnetic hypersensitivity , as Chuck believes he suffers from EHS .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Jimmy later hires Huell to serve as a bodyguard while Jimmy conducts his business re-selling pre-paid cellular phones .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Huell is arrested after he inadvertently assaults a police officer while protecting Jimmy , and faces up to two and a half years in prison as a result .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Jimmy 's law license is still suspended , so he brings in Kim Wexler to defend Huell .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Huell plans to flee rather than go to prison , so Kim and Jimmy forge dozens of letters describing Huell as a hero and denouncing his arrest .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: The con forces the prosecutor to accept a plea bargain that ensures Huell does not go to prison .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: As part of their plot against Howard Hamlin , Jimmy and Kim enlist Huell 's help to make a copy of Howard 's car keys with the help of one of Huell 's associates .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: After successfully making the keys , Huell questions why Jimmy and Kim are bothering with such illegal activity when they have legitimate jobs as great lawyers .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: In Breaking Bad , when Ted Beneke goes on a spending spree with the money Skyler arranged to give him , rather than paying his IRS debt as she intended , Huell and Kuby intimidate him into paying the IRS .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Though they did not intend violence , Ted attempts to flee , falls , and suffers head and neck injuries that leave him paraplegic .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: In " Buried " , Saul sends Huell and Kuby to collect Walt 's money from a storage locker , and in " Confessions " , Saul tasks Huell with pickpocketing Jesse 's marijuana so Jesse will not be high when he contacts

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Ed the " disappearer " for a new identity .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: It is while Jesse is waiting for Ed that he realizes his marijuana is gone and understands that Huell had earlier pickpocketed from him the ricin cigarette that Walt had intended for Jesse to use in killing Gus. Jesse 's realization that Huell stole the ricin cigarette enables him to understand that Walt must have poisoned Brock in order to turn Jesse against Gus ( which is true , although Walt did not use ricin ) .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Hank and Gomez later interrogate Huell to learn where Walt hid his money , telling him falsely that Walt intends to kill him to ensure that no one can trace Walt 's drug - dealing past .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: They use a staged photo of Jesse , who appears to have been killed with a gunshot to the head , to coax Huell into revealing that he and Kuby packed Walt 's money into seven barrels , then loaded the barrels into a rented van .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Huell also reveals that the van was so dirty on the outside when Walt returned that they washed it before returning it , implying that Walt 's money was buried somewhere in the desert .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Hank and Gomez tell Huell to wait until they come back for him , but they are killed and never return .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Six years after Huell 's final appearance on Breaking Bad , and three days before the release of El Camino : A Breaking Bad Movie , a countdown was shared on Breaking Bad 's social media channels .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Throughout the countdown , multiple videos were shown of Huell still sitting impatiently in the safehouse where Hank and Gomez left him , watching the events of " Felina " on the news .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Upon the countdown 's conclusion , Huell , now tired of waiting , says " screw this " , puts on his jacket and leaves the safehouse as the title credits of El Camino appear on his television .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: In the Better Call Saul episode " Breaking Bad " , Francesca tells Saul that Huell is back home in New Orleans now .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: As the DEA had taken him in under false pretenses , they were forced to let him go in the end .

text: Patrick Kuby

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Patrick Kuby ( played by Bill Burr ) is one of Saul Goodman 's hired hands .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: He assists in facilitating the car wash sale to the Whites by impersonating an environmental inspector , and later intimidates Ted Beneke with Huell 's help .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: He also aids Walt , Jesse , and Mike in their train robbery and helps Huell collect Walt 's money from storage .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Before moving to Albuquerque , Kuby was involved in organized crime in Boston .

text: Ed Galbraith

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Ed Galbraith ( played by Robert Forster ) , also known as " the Disappearer " , specializes in providing fugitives with new identities and new places to live .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: He operates a legitimate vacuum sales and service center , Best Quality Vacuum , as a front for this criminal business .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Though mentioned in earlier episodes ( such as in " Crawl Space " ) ,

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Ed first appears in " Granite State " .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: As Walter is identified as Heisenberg and becomes the target of a manhunt , both Walt and Saul seek Ed 's criminal services .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Ed first helps Saul escape to Omaha , Nebraska .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: He later takes Walter White to New Hampshire , hiding him away in a cabin in a rural area .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: During Walt 's time in hiding , Ed often visits Walt , bringing him supplies and administering chemotherapy , though he warns that if Walt leaves the location , their business relationship will be over for good .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: A lonely Walt also takes to paying Ed to spend time with him and play cards .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: In El Camino , Jesse approaches Ed for relocation .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Ed demands $ 125,000 to aid Jesse , plus $ 125,000 for the previous occasion Jesse was supposed to use his services , but failed to appear .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Jesse is $ 1,800 short and Ed refuses to help .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: After Jesse obtains the money , Ed smuggles him to a car parked near Haines , Alaska and provides him with false identification and a cover story .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Jesse gives

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Ed a farewell letter for Brock Cantillo , which Ed promises to mail from Mexico City in the near future , wishing Jesse luck on his new life and noting that not many people like them get a fresh start .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: In Better Call Saul , in the flashforward at the beginning of season 5's " Magic Man " , ( set after the events of El Camino ) Saul ( in his new identity as Gene Takavic ) calls Ed for a second extraction after a cab driver named Jeff recognizes him .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Ed recognizes Saul 's voice and agrees to a second extraction , warning that it will cost double .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Saul agrees and Ed schedules the extraction and location , but after a moment of consideration , Saul changes his mind and tells Ed that he will " fix it [ himself ] " instead .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: In Better Call Saul season 6's " Axe and Grind " , Saul and Kim Wexler look at Dr. Caldera 's little black book of criminal contacts , which are all coded .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: However , amongst the pages are several Best Quality Vacuum business cards , revealing that Caldera has connections to Ed and also possibly explaining how Saul ultimately first becomes aware of Ed and his services .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Kim looks at one of the cards with confusion and interest for a moment before putting it away again .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: In the series finale , " Saul Gone " , Saul attempts to call Ed for another extraction after his cover is finally blown , but Saul is captured by the police before he can make the call .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Robert Forster 's appearances as Ed in El Camino and Better Call Saul were among his final roles .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: He died of brain cancer on October 11 , 2019 , the same day the movie was released , though he appeared in Better Call Saul as Ed posthumously .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Ed is one of the only five characters to appear in Breaking Bad , Better Call Saul , and El Camino , along with Mike Ehrmantraut , Walter White , Jesse Pinkman , and Austin Ramey .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: The Better Call Saul episode " Magic Man " was dedicated to Forster .

text: Joey Dixon

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Marshall Joseph " Joey " Dixon ( played by Josh Fadem ) , aka Camera Guy , is the cameraman of the college filmmaking crew Jimmy McGill occasionally uses to shoot TV ads and other events .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Jimmy originally referred to him only as Camera Guy .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Jimmy also initially refers to the other crew members only by the functions they perform .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: After graduating , Joey is shown guest lecturing at the college and working in its audiovisual equipment center .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: He , Phil , and Cheri would go on to create the " Filmmaker Training " series of videos of informational tips and tricks for filmmaking , in which Kim also made an appearance .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Phil Phil ( played by Julian Bonfiglio ) , also known as Sound Guy , handles the microphones and audio for the college filmmaking crew Jimmy sometimes hires .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Cheri Cheri ( played by Hayley Holmes ) , also known as Drama Girl or Make - Up Girl , assists Joey 's film crew and also arranges hair and make - up for individuals preparing to appear on camera .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: First referred to as Make - Up Girl , she later indicates she has been attending acting classes .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: After she impersonates several individuals on the phone to provide testimonials for Huell in " Coushatta " , Jimmy begins referring to her as Drama Girl .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: In " Winner " , Jimmy and Kim fake several events designed to show Jimmy 's remorse over Chuck 's death , hoping this will lead to reinstatement of his law license .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: During a catered celebration to mark the dedication of a law library in Chuck 's name , Cheri works as a waitress and aids Jimmy and Kim 's deception by spreading the story among guests that Jimmy anonymously financed the project .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: When Jimmy and Kim need to re-shoot their photos of the actor pretending to be the Sandpiper case mediator , Cheri arrives on short notice to work on his hair and make - up .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Because she has been pulled from a dress rehearsal for a stage adaptation of The Dark Crystal , she arrives in her Kira character 's make - up and costume .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Irene Landry Irene Landry ( played by Jean Effron ) is an elderly client of Jimmy and resident of Sandpiper Crossing .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: When she tells Jimmy she can not afford a will he proposes and can pay him after receiving her allowance from Sandpiper , it leads to Jimmy discovering that the nursing home has been overcharging its residents .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Irene later becomes the class representative of the Sandpiper Crossing class-action lawsuit .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: When she waits to accept a settlement offer proposed by Erin Brill on the advice of her lawyers as they could obtain a bigger settlement , Jimmy turns her friends against her in an attempt to manipulate her into accepting the offer immediately , but out of regret helps Irene regain her friends by discrediting himself .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Irene eventually accepts the original offer , however , after Jimmy and Kim sabotage Howard and force a settlement .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Ira Ira ( played by Franc Ross ) is a professional burglar and the owner of Vamonos Pest , a pest control company which fronts for his burglaries and later Walter White 's meth business .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: In Better Call Saul , Ira works as a vending machine beverage distributor and can be contacted through Dr. Caldera .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: He is hired by Jimmy to steal a valuable Hummel figurine from Neff Copiers , which he replaces with a similar one .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: After splitting the proceeds from the sale of the figurine with Jimmy , Ira reveals he uses a new phone for every job , which gives Jimmy the idea to start a business of selling prepaid mobile phones to street criminals .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Clarence Clarence ( played by David Mattey ) , nicknamed " Man Mountain " , is an Albuquerque hoodlum who hires himself out for illegal " muscle " work through Dr. Caldera .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Alongside Mike and Sobchak , he is hired as one of Pryce 's bodyguards for a deal with Nacho , but flees after seeing Mike disarm Sobchak .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Man Mountain later assists Jimmy ( along with Huell ) in intimidating three juvenile delinquents who mugged him when he was selling burner phones and sells churros to Jimmy 's criminal clients during an event to publicize his reinstated legal services .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Man Mountain also appears in El Camino , in which he now works as a bouncer and brings three prostitutes to Neil Kandy and his friends for their party .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: He sleeps in his car while the others celebrate .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: In the film , his real name is revealed to be Clarence .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: He is one of only two characters ( alongside Suzanne Ericsen ) to appear in Better Call Saul and El Camino but not Breaking Bad .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Lance Lance ( played by Elisha Yaffe ) is a cashier at the copy shop where Jimmy doctors Chuck 's Mesa Verde documents .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Jimmy bribes Lance to lie for him when Ernesto brings Chuck to the store to question him .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Genidowski Genidowski ( played by Lennie Loftin ) is a con man hired by Jimmy and Kim to pose as Howard 's private investigator .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: He gives Howard photos that appear to show Jimmy bribing the judge Rand Casimiro , then secretly switches them with innocuous photos of Jimmy that Julie brings to Howard during the Sandpiper mediation session .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: When Howard tries to call him again , he discovers that Genidowski is a fraud .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Lenny Lenny ( played by John Ennis ) is a grocery store employee and amateur actor hired by Jimmy and Kim to impersonate the judge Rand Casimiro in still photos , as part of their ploy to discredit Howard Hamlin and force a settlement on the Sandpiper Crossing class-action lawsuit .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Jeff ( portrayed by Don Harvey in seasons 4 – 5 and Pat Healy in season 6 ) is an eccentric cab driver from Albuquerque who recognizes Jimmy under his Gene Takavic identity in Omaha .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Jeff approaches Jimmy on his lunchbreak with his friend Buddy and asks Jimmy to do his iconic " Better Call Saul ! " catchphrase and point .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Although initially hesitant Jimmy gives in and Jeff tells him to ask for him whenever he needs a ride .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Jimmy finds and befriends Jeff 's mother , Marion , and she invites him back to her house .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: While there Jeff confronts Jimmy , and Jimmy offers to get him into " the game " .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Jeff , Jimmy , and Buddy plan a robbery at the mall where Jimmy works .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Jimmy creates a floor plan of the store they will be robbing and recreates it in an open field for Jeff to practice his route .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: When the day of the robbery arrives , Jimmy distracts the security guard while Jeff robs the store .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: All is going well until Jeff slips and knocks himself out , forcing Jimmy to fake a depressive episode until he can regain consciousness .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Eventually , Jeff wakes up and completes the robbery .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Afterward as the three of them are celebrating , Jimmy reveals that he purposely set up the robbery in such a way that if Jeff tries to snitch on his true identity they will both be arrested .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: As he leaves , Marion tells Jimmy that she thinks he is a good influence on Jeff .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Jimmy later resumes working with Jeff and his friend Buddy in a new series of scams involving identity theft .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Buddy backs out when he learns their latest target has cancer ; Gene cuts him out of the operation and forces Jeff to drive him to the man 's house so that he can break in himself .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: While Gene is inside , Jeff panics when he sees a police car idling behind him and crashes his taxi into a parked vehicle , leading to his arrest .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: In addition , the homeowner came out and accused Jeff of robbing him , adding to his legal troubles .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Gene promises to bail out Jeff and calls Marion asking her to accompany him , but Marion becomes suspicious and uses the laptop Jeff bought her with the department store money to discover Gene 's true identity as Saul Goodman .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: When Gene is arrested , no mention is made of his crimes from Omaha so it 's unclear what happened to Jeff afterwards , but Gene had told Jeff that there was no proof of Jeff having committed the robbery and he could likely get those charges dismissed .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Buddy Buddy ( portrayed by Max Bickelhaup ) is a friend of Jeff who accompanies him to the mall when Jeff approaches Jimmy under his " Gene Takavic " alias and has him admit his true identity .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Jimmy later offers to get Jeff into " the game " by training him and Buddy in robbing a department store at the mall where Jimmy works .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Buddy sneaks Jeff into the mall by having him lay in a shipping container and transporting it into the department store 's loading dock .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Jimmy convinces the store 's supervisor over the phone to hold the container overnight , allowing Jeff to enter the store during after - hours and steal expensive merchandise .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: After the robbery is complete , Jimmy warns Jeff and Buddy to stay away from him lest he report the crime to the authorities .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Jimmy later re-enlists Jeff and Buddy in a new series of cons where Jimmy befriends wealthy single men at bars and gets them drunk , Jeff drives them home while giving them water laced with barbiturates , and Buddy breaks into the marks ' homes while they are unconscious and photographs their IDs and financial records , which Jeff later sells to a broker .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: However , Buddy backs out of the con when their latest target is found to have pancreatic cancer , which Buddy 's father suffered from .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Jimmy cuts Buddy out of the operation and forces Jeff to drive him to the target 's house so he can break in himself .

text: Bill Oakley William Oakley ( portrayed by Peter Diseth ) is a deputy district attorney who has a friendly rivalry with Jimmy .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: When Jimmy goes to work as an associate at Davis & Main , Oakley expresses envy at his salary and fringe benefits .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: When Jimmy is arrested for the break in at Chuck 's , Oakley first appears to gloat at Jimmy 's booking , but then offers to expedite the proceedings by getting Jimmy 's first court appearance moved up on the docket .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Rich Schweikart

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Richard Schweikart ( played by Dennis Boutsikaris ) is the co-founder of the Schweikart & Cokely ( S&C ) law firm .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Rich is the lead attorney for the Sandpiper retirement homes in HHM 's lawsuit against the company .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: He observes that Kim Wexler is both highly skilled and underappreciated at HHM , and offers her a job at S&C , which she declines .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Kim later starts a solo practice with Mesa Verde Bank as her only client , but begins to spend more time and effort on pro bono criminal defense cases that she finds more appealing than banking law .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: She approaches Rich about joining S&C , and becomes a partner in charge of the firm 's new banking division , including the Mesa Verde account .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Kim devotes increasing time and effort to her pro bono cases , which eventually causes her to quit S&C and her representation of Mesa Verde .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: When Jimmy and Kim 's tricks lead to Howard 's erratic behavior at a mediation session for the Sandpiper case , Rich succeeds at compelling Hamlin , Hamlin & McGill and Davis & Main to accept a lower settlement than what they wanted .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: After Howard 's death , Rich attends his funeral at HHM , expressing his admiration and respect for Howard and revealing to Jimmy and Kim that HHM is downsizing , moving to a smaller office , and changing the firm 's name .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Cliff Main

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Clifford Main ( played by Ed Begley Jr. ) is a senior partner at the Davis & Main law firm in Santa Fe.

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: When the Sandpiper case becomes too big for HHM alone , they affiliate with D&M .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Kim recommends Jimmy to Cliff , and D&M hires Jimmy as an associate .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Jimmy 's unauthorized airing of a television ad soliciting clients for the Sandpiper lawsuit angers Cliff and the firm 's partners .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: The ensuing scrutiny of his work motivates Jimmy to quit , but the possibility of losing his signing bonus leads him to instead cause trouble around the workplace and antagonize his colleagues .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Cliff eventually fires him and says letting Jimmy keep the bonus is worth it to be rid of him .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: When Jimmy and Kim decide to obtain Jimmy 's share of the settlement or judgment sooner by forcing a resolution of the Sandpiper case , they take advantage of Cliff 's friendship with Howard to smear Howard 's reputation .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: In the process , Kim impresses Cliff who offers to use his connections to help her build a legitimate pro bono law firm .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Initially receptive , Kim ultimately prioritizes the plan to ruin Howard .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Kim and Jimmy convince Cliff and the counsel for Sandpiper that Howard is an unstable cocaine addict , so Cliff cuts ties with Howard and settles the Sandpiper case himself .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Following Howard 's unexpected murder , Cliff and the New Mexico legal community are fooled into believing it was a suicide .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Cliff comforts Cheryl , Howard 's widow , at the memorial service .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Kim lies to Cheryl about the addiction and Cliff regretfully informs her of Howard 's erratic behavior , which convinces Cheryl of the con .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Erin Brill Erin Brill ( portrayed by Jessie Ennis ) is a second - year associate at Davis & Main .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: She is assigned to supervise Jimmy after he runs afoul of his D&M bosses , which serves as one of the motivations for him to quit .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: When Irene , the class representative in the lawsuit against Sandpiper Crossing , turns down a proposed resolution because the lawyers convince her waiting will result in a bigger settlement , her friends turn against her .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Jimmy wants his share of the judgment sooner , so he tricks her into accepting , but her friends remain distrustful .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Jimmy then arranges for Irene and her friends to overhear him confessing his tricks to Erin , which prevents the case from being resolved immediately but restores Irene 's friendships .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: As the case continues , a meeting of residents at Sandpiper 's Albuquerque facility reveals they are considering accepting the company 's offer .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Erin 's attempt to mollify them begins to go off track , but Howard 's timely intervention causes them to agree to continue holding out for a bigger settlement .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Erin manages the conference call during the Sandpiper mediation conference and is the first to notice that Howard 's eyes have dilated from contact with the drug Jimmy and Kim procured from Dr. Caldera .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: After the case is settled , Erin announces the resolution to the conference call participants .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Omar Omar ( portrayed by Omar Maskati ) is an employee at Davis & Main who befriends Jimmy during his brief stint at the firm .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: He shows Jimmy an old television commercial by D&M , which inspires Jimmy to make his own , and also helps Jimmy with writing his resignation letter .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: After Jimmy quits D&M , Omar helps him move his cocobolo desk to his old office .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Brian Archuleta Brian Archuleta ( portrayed by Luis Bordonada ) is an employee at Davis & Main and a minor participant in the Sandpiper case .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Jimmy targets him and Doug Lynton in one of his attempts to get fired , by staining their suits with his smoothie .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Brian later attends Chuck 's funeral .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Doug Lynton Doug Lynton ( portrayed by David Grant Wright ) is a partner at Davis & Main .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: He scolds Jimmy for airing his Sandpiper commercial without D&M 's consent and wants to fire him , but Cliff gives Jimmy a second chance .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Jimmy later targets him and Brian Archuleta in one of his attempts to get fired , by staining their suits with his smoothie .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Cordova Cordova ( portrayed by Lucinda Marker ) is a partner at Davis & Main .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: She scolds Jimmy for airing his Sandpiper commercial without D&M 's consent and wants to fire him , but Cliff gives Jimmy a second chance .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Paige Novick Paige Novick ( portrayed by Cara Pifko ) is the senior counsel of Mesa Verde .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: When Kim is relegated to menial document review work at Hamlin , Hamlin & McGill , she works her professional , personal , and law school contacts in hopes that landing a major new client will help get her back in Howard 's good graces .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Paige and Kim were law school classmates , which leads to Paige and Mesa Verde CEO Kevin Wachtell bringing the bank 's business to HHM .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: When Kim leaves HHM , Kevin and Paige agree that Mesa Verde will be a client of her new firm , but Chuck succeeds at winning them back to HHM .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Jimmy 's sabotage of Chuck 's Mesa Verde work causes Kevin and Paige to return to Kim .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: After Jimmy and Kim humiliate Chuck at Jimmy 's bar disciplinary hearing in order to prevent Jimmy 's disbarment , Paige gloats over Chuck 's demise , which causes Kim to feel guilty and visibly angers her .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: As Kim becomes disillusioned with Mesa Verde 's tactics , she and Paige are sometimes at odds .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: After Kim surrenders her law license , she mentions that Paige has agreed to take on her clients .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Suzanne Ericsen Suzanne Ericsen ( portrayed by Julie Pearl ) is a deputy district attorney .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: When Huell is arrested , Suzanne refuses to negotiate , so Jimmy and Kim trick her into agreeing to a plea bargain .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: When Jimmy , now practicing law as Saul Goodman , attempts to negotiate several plea deals at once , Suzanne refuses , so he arranges a situation that enables him to trick her into accepting .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Suzanne and the detective investigating the murder Lalo committed under an alias later connect Jimmy to Lalo and Nacho , and Suzanne asks Kim to persuade Jimmy to inform on the Salamancas .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: In El Camino , Suzanne is visible on a television screen as she stands behind SAC Austin Ramey while Ramey briefs reporters about the events that took place at Jack 's compound .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: In " Saul Gone " , she calls Kim to inform her of Saul 's arrest and says he is going to give testimony that impacts Kim .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: She is one of only two characters ( alongside Clarence ) to appear in Better Call Saul and El Camino but not Breaking Bad .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Kyra Hay Kyra Hay ( portrayed by Kimberly Hébert Gregory ) is a deputy district attorney from Belen , New Mexico .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: After Jimmy is arrested for breaking into Chuck 's house to destroy a tape of his confession to falsifying the Mesa Verde documents , she is appointed by Bill Oakley to prosecute Jimmy in court .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: At Chuck 's suggestion , Hay offers Jimmy a pre-prosecution diversion ( PPD ) that would require him to confess his crimes to the state bar association in exchange for avoiding prison time .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: During a meeting between Jimmy , Kim , Chuck and Howard to finalize Jimmy 's confession , she insists Jimmy to apologize to Chuck for his actions .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Viola Goto Viola Goto ( portrayed by Keiko Agena ) is a paralegal who works for Kim Wexler .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: When Kim leaves Hamlin Hamlin & McGill to begin a solo practice , Mesa Verde Bank retains her as their outside counsel and Kim hires Viola to assist her .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: When Kim becomes bored with banking law and begins to accept pro bono criminal defense cases , she hands off more and more of her Mesa Verde work to Viola .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Kim later convinces Schweikart & Cokely ( S&C ) to hire her as a partner in charge of their new banking division , with Mesa Verde as their major banking client , and Viola follows Kim to S&C .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: When Kim aids Jimmy to defend Huell Babineaux during Jimmy 's law license suspension , Viola assists Kim in researching the relevant statutes so Jimmy and Kim can plan their defense .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: After Kim asks Jimmy to represent Everett Acker to prevent Acker from being evicted by Mesa Verde , Viola provides Kim frequent updates about Jimmy 's machinations .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Viola is present at the meeting between Kim , Kevin Wachtell , Paige Novick , Rich Schweikart and Jimmy ( as Saul Goodman ) when Jimmy shocks everyone by making exorbitant demands of Kevin , then pressuring Kevin to agree to a better deal for Acker than what Kevin had previously been willing to accept .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: When Kim leaves S&C , Viola continues to work there as a paralegal .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: After Jimmy and Kim decide to force a settlement of the Sandpiper case by ruining Howard 's reputation , Kim meets with Viola , ostensibly to apologize for abruptly leaving S&C.

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Viola tells Kim she admires Kim 's commitment to helping pro bono clients who have nowhere else to turn , but the meeting is a ploy .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: S&C represents the Sandpiper Crossing nursing home chain , and Kim uses her conversation with Viola to obtain the name of the retired judge who will mediate the Sandpiper case .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Kim and Jimmy hire an actor to impersonate Casimiro and stage photos depicting Jimmy offering Casimiro a $ 20,000 cash bribe , which they pass onto Howard Hamlin via his private investigator ( who is in fact a con man working for Kim and Jimmy ) .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Howard believes he recognizes Casimiro from the photos during the settlement conference and embarrasses himself in front of his peers by accusing Casimiro of corruption , derailing the meeting and forcing HHM to accept a lower settlement than they initially sought , when it is definitively revealed he did not see the actual Casimiro at the scene .
