text: Everett Acker

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Everett Acker ( portrayed by Barry Corbin ) is a retiree whose home is on land leased from Mesa Verde Bank .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Kim Wexler represents the bank in its attempt to evict Acker so it can construct a new call center .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: When Kim becomes sympathetic to Acker 's refusal to leave , she persuades Jimmy ( as Saul Goodman ) to represent him .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: As of 2004 , Acker has lived at the same location since 1974 .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: When Mesa Verde Bank begins buying out leases in order to construct a call center as part of its regional expansion , Acker becomes the last holdout .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Though his lease includes a provision for the bank to buy him out at fair market value plus $ 5,000 , he considers the buyout provision to be unfair , even with Mesa Verde 's $ 18,000 bonus offer .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Kim recommends to Kevin and Paige an alternate building site that will enable Mesa Verde to work around Acker 's refusal to leave , but they insist on eviction .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: She asks Jimmy ( as Saul ) to represent Acker against Mesa Verde , and Acker agrees .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Jimmy creates delays in Mesa Verde 's eviction through several tricks , including changing Acker 's street number and claiming the eviction notices are for the wrong address , creating fake Native American artifacts to be found by researchers , planting low - level radioactive material to have authorities test the site for hazardous waste , and passing off a spray - painted image of Jesus on Acker 's home as a miracle that causes the religious faithful to consider it a shrine .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Kim and Jimmy consider blackmailing Kevin into settling , but Kim changes her mind and offers an improved settlement , with her personally making up the difference between what Kevin agrees to pay and a $ 75,000 total .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Jimmy says Acker already agreed to accept $ 45,000 , so he concurs .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Jimmy meets with Kim , Rich , Kevin , and Paige to complete the arrangement and stuns everyone by demanding $ 4 million .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: When Kevin ridicules this demand , Jimmy shows him rough cuts of commercials seeking plaintiffs for class-action lawsuits against Mesa Verde , which unfavorably depict Kevin 's father , Don Wachtell .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Jimmy also makes use of the blackmail material Kim declined to employ — photos that prove Mesa Verde 's logo is based on an original photograph the bank did not obtain permission to use .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Jimmy uses the threat of lawsuits and an injunction against displaying the logo to persuade Kevin to accept a settlement that includes $ 75,000 in cash for Acker and permission to remain in his home .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Hugo Archilleya Hugo Archilleya ( played by Pierre Barrera ) is a former custodian at JP Wynne High School .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: When Walt had to leave class to vomit ( a consequence of his chemotherapy ) , Hugo comforted him and cleaned up after him .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: After the DEA connects missing school equipment to methamphetamine production , Hugo is one of the initial suspects because of the access his custodial duties afford him .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Hugo is soon placed under arrest for possession of marijuana and fired ; after a search of his home , more marijuana is found but no methamphetamine or items that could connect him with the meth investigation .

text: Captain Bauer

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Bauer ( played by Brendan Fehr ) is a captain in the Air Force whom Jimmy tricks into gaining him , his client Fudge and film crew access to an airbase .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: As part of Jimmy 's scheme , Bauer mistakes Fudge as a war veteran and takes Jimmy 's group to FIFI , a World War II-era Boeing B - 29 Superfortress , where they film a commercial while Bauer gets water for Fudge .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Bauer returns with a group of soldiers for a photo with Fudge .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: He later finds out about the deception and confronts Jimmy in his office , demanding him to stop broadcasting the commercial .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: When Jimmy refuses , Bauer storms off and yells that Jimmy can not be trusted in front of his clients .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Ted Beneke Theodore " Ted " Beneke ( played by Christopher Cousins ) is the president and owner of Beneke Fabricators .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: He gives Skyler her old job back as his accountant during the second season .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Ted has always been attracted to Skyler but does not make any advances after she returns .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Ted commits tax fraud to keep the company alive and save everyone 's jobs , which he admits to Skyler when she finds irregularities in the company 's books .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Skyler has an affair with Ted in season three to exact revenge upon Walt , but ignores Ted 's offer to leave some of her things at his house .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: When Walt finds out about their affair , he tries to confront Ted , who hides in his office .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: This escalates into a scene where Walt is escorted out by security guards and the company staff becomes aware of Skyler 's relationship with Ted .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Skyler gets angry at Ted when he shows up at her house to ask about their relationship , and she later severs both her personal and professional ties with him .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: In season 4 , Ted meets with Skyler , who is now running a car wash , and notifies her of an Internal Revenue Service ( IRS ) investigation into his company 's taxes .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Since Skyler kept the books , she can be linked to Ted 's tax fraud , likely placing her entire family under surveillance , so she intervenes by pretending at Ted 's meeting with the IRS to be an unqualified bookkeeper hired only for her looks .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Her supposed incompetence forestalls a full investigation , provided Ted pays the back taxes and penalties .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Skyler arranges to provide Ted the money by using the proceeds from Walt 's meth production to have Saul pretend a long - lost dead relative in Luxembourg left Ted an inheritance .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Saul discovers that instead of paying the IRS , Ted leased a new Mercedes and is using the funds to reopen his business .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: When Skyler urges Ted to pay the IRS first , he refuses , so Skyler tells him the money came from her .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Ted still refuses to pay the IRS and Skyler perceives him to be blackmailing her into paying both his tax bill and the costs to reopen his business .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Skyler has Saul send two of his men —Huell and Kuby — to force Beneke to write the check to the IRS .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: They succeed , but Ted panics and attempts to flee , tripping on a loose rug and crashing headfirst into a counter .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: At the start of the fifth season , Saul informs Skyler that something happened to Ted , causing her to conclude that he died .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Saul tells her that Ted is alive , but hospitalized .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: When Skyler visits him , she sees that Ted is rigidly sitting upright and wearing a halo brace .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Ted tells Skyler he lied to medical personnel and police , claiming his broken neck resulted from an accidental fall , and that because he fears for the safety of his family , he will never mention how the injury occurred .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Recognizing that Ted has been intimidated into keeping quiet about the source of his money , Skyler goes along with Ted 's perception by coldly replying " Good " to his promise of silence .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Rebecca Bois Rebecca Bois ( played by Ann Cusack ) is Chuck McGill 's ex-wife and a concert violinist .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Although their divorce was amicable , it is stated that Chuck 's electromagnetic hypersensitivity started soon afterwards .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: In 2002 , Chuck attempted to reconcile and reconnect with Rebecca over dinner with Jimmy 's help .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: He lies to Rebecca about his symptoms and becomes overwhelmed when Rebecca takes a phone call .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Chuck slaps the phone from Rebecca 's hand in a fit and rather than apologizing , calls Rebecca rude for taking a call at dinner .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Rebecca leaves soon after .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Later Jimmy invites Rebecca to his disciplinary hearing while Chuck is on the stand .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Chuck apologizes for hiding his disability from her to which she shows complete sympathy and understanding , wondering why he did not simply tell her in the first place .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: However , when it is shown that Chuck does not in fact suffer from EHS , Rebecca watches in horror as Chuck rants about Jimmy .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: After the hearing Rebecca tries to talk with Chuck in his house but he refuses to talk .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: She visits a celebrating Jimmy and Kim in their office and begs Jimmy to make amends with Chuck but Jimmy refuses .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Realizing she was just a pawn to help his case , Rebecca tells Jimmy that Chuck was right about him .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: After Chuck 's death Rebecca attends his funeral crying profusely .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Afterwards as Chuck 's will is being read it is revealed that Chuck left his house ( which is mostly a burnt - out wreck after Chuck 's suicide ) to Rebecca , although she allows Jimmy to take anything he wishes from it .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Brenda Brenda ( played by Sarah Minnich ) is a former secretary at HHM .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: She is one of the many guests at Jesse 's house when he throws parties to distract himself from his guilt over killing Gale , indicating she may have been dealing with the consequences of HHM 's downfall .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: David Brightbill David Brightbill ( portrayed by Jackamoe Buzzell ) is a private investigator .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: After Jimmy sabotages Chuck 's work for Mesa Verde Bank , Chuck hires David to find proof .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: When Chuck records Jimmy 's confession and arranges for Jimmy to find out , David and Howard Hamlin spend time at Chuck 's house because Chuck is sure Jimmy will try to steal the recording and wants them to observe firsthand .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Jimmy later angrily breaks down Chuck 's door and destroys the cassette , and David and Howard reveal themselves as witnesses , which enables Chuck to report Jimmy 's crime to the police .

text: Maureen Bruckner Maureen Bruckner ( played by Poorna Jagannathan ) is a specialist from Johns Hopkins Hospital hired by Gus to treat Hector after his stroke .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: She can speak Spanish .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Gus later invites Dr. Bruckner to his house for dinner to celebrate Hector recuperating , but tells her they are ending the treatment when she discusses helping Hector to walk and talk again .

text: Dr. Caldera

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Dr. Caldera ( played by Joe DeRosa ) is an Albuquerque veterinarian .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: He secretly serves as a middleman to put criminals in contact with each other .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: In one instance , when Daniel Wormald desires to have a bodyguard when he carries out a drug deal with Nacho Varga , he contacts Caldera , who puts three individuals including Mike Ehrmantraut in touch with Wormald .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: In addition , Caldera sometimes renders " off the books " medical aid to criminals , enabling them to avoid having their wounds reported to the police .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Individuals who visit his office for criminal activities often bring pets with them , enabling Caldera 's examination of the animal to serve as a cover for the visit 's real purpose .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: As revealed in season 6's " Axe and Grind " , Caldera has a connection to Ed Galbraith , the " disappearer " .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: In the same episode , Caldera reveals that he is retiring from his role as a middleman and shows Jimmy and Kim his encoded notebook of criminal contacts that he intends to sell .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: In a flashforward in " Wine and Roses " , Caldera 's notebook is amongst the possessions being shown taken from Saul 's mansion , suggesting that Saul is the one who eventually bought it from him .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Tomás Cantillo Tomás Cantillo ( played by Angelo Martinez ) is Andrea Cantillo 's younger brother .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: He murdered Jesse 's friend Combo on the orders of rival drug dealers .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: After Jesse learns the truth , the dealers murder Tomás , possibly with the permission of their boss Gus Fring .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Jesse 's effort to seek revenge leads to a rift between Gus , Walt and Jesse .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Clovis Clovis ( played by Tom Kiesche ) is Badger 's cousin who operates a vehicle towing and repair service .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: When Jesse 's RV quits running , Clovis charges him an exorbitant amount to tow and store the vehicle , due to its cargo .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Clovis repairs the RV and catches Jesse sleeping in it after Jesse has scaled the fence ( and destroyed a portable toilet in the process ) after being evicted from his home .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Clovis orders Jesse to pay for the repairs and property damage and then threatens to sell off Jesse 's inventory to cover the repairs , when Jesse claims he can not furnish immediate payment .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Jesse again breaks into the gated lot and drives through the gate without paying for the repairs .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: He later returns to pay Clovis for the repairs and damages and arranges to store the RV inside Clovis 's gated lot for $ 500 per week .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Clovis later sells Jesse a used red Toyota Tercel hatchback .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Jesse decides to retrieve the RV , but Walter has warned Clovis that the DEA is looking for it , forcing Clovis to bring it to a junkyard to be destroyed .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Louis Corbett Louis Corbett ( played by Kyle Swimmer in season one and Caleb Landry Jones in seasons two and three ) is Walter Jr. 's best friend .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: They both attend JP Wynne High School .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: He frequently gives Walter Jr. rides to school and helps him set up a PayPal account for donations to Walter Jr. 's website .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: David David ( played by Reed Diamond ) is a sommelier at a restaurant apparently frequented by Gus .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: He is close with Gus , who had even hinted to having a romantic interest in him , and bonds with him over wine .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: After getting away with killing Lalo , Gus celebrates by conversing with him , with David offering him a bottle to try .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Before he comes back , Gus leaves , unable to separate himself from his quest to avenge Max , his deceased partner .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Dr. Delcavoli Dr. Delcavoli ( played by David House ) is Walt 's physician during the first two seasons .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: He is said to be one of the top 10 oncologists in the United States .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Stephanie Doswell Stephanie Doswell ( played by Jennifer Hasty ) is a realtor with Venture Realty Group .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: She hosts two open houses that Marie attends .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: During the second , she recognizes Marie from their last meeting and as the one who stole from a spoon collection at the previous house .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: She scuffles with Marie over her purse , before Marie is arrested .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: In Better Call Saul , she runs a tour of a house for Stacey Ehrmantraut , who buys it .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Kaylee Ehrmantraut Kaylee Ehrmantraut ( played by Kaija Roze Bales in Breaking Bad , Faith Healey in Better Call Saul season 1 , Abigail Zoe Lewis in Better Call Saul seasons 2 - 4 and Juliet Donenfeld in Better Call Saul seasons 5 and 6 ) is Mike Ehrmantraut 's granddaughter , whom Mike occasionally spends time with .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: After Mike 's death , Jesse decides to deliver a bag containing $ 2.5 million to Kaylee , but Walter stops the transfer .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Stacey Ehrmantraut

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Stacey Ehrmantraut ( portrayed by Kerry Condon ) is Mike Ehrmantraut 's widowed daughter - in - law and the mother of Kaylee , Mike 's granddaughter .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Fran Fran ( portrayed by Debrianna Mansini ) is a waitress at Loyola 's Family Restaurant who often serves Mike , a regular customer .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: According to series creator Vince Gilligan , she was named after the original owner of Walter White 's house .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Cheryl Hamlin

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Cheryl Hamlin ( portrayed by Sandrine Holt ) is Howard Hamlin 's wife .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: In " Axe and Grind " , Howard presents a coffee topped with the latte art of a peace sign to Cheryl , from whom he is obviously estranged .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: She dismissively pours it into a travel mug , destroying the art .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Howard tells her about the problem he has been having with Jimmy and says that he is attempting to solve it .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Cheryl is widowed in the episode " Plan and Execution " when Lalo Salamanca shoots and kills Howard .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: In " Fun and Games " , Cheryl is present at Howard 's HHM memorial service .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Jimmy and Kim attempt to provide condolences , but she mentions that Howard informed her of their harassment campaign .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: When she expresses suspicions of Jimmy and Kim 's story about Howard 's death , because she does not believe he used cocaine , Kim fabricates a story about seeing Howard abusing drugs while she was still at HHM .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Kim then shifts blame by suggesting Cheryl was inattentive and failed to notice Howard 's supposed drug problem , causing Cheryl to break down in tears .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: After deciding to confess in 2010 , Kim visits Cheryl with an affidavit detailing Kim and Jimmy 's destruction of Howard 's reputation , as well as the real circumstances surrounding his death , keeping secret only her knowledge of Jimmy 's identity and location .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Kim says she has given a copy of the document to the district attorney , but surmises that she will not face prosecution given the lack of physical evidence and witnesses .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: When Jimmy hires Bill Oakley as his defense counsel , Oakley informs Jimmy of Kim 's confession and suggests that Cheryl has ample grounds for a wrongful death lawsuit , stating that Cheryl is " out shopping for lawyers as we speak . "

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Troy Hoffman and Jack Fensky Troy Hoffman ( played by Lane Garrison ) and his sergeant Jack Fensky ( played by Billy Malone ) are corrupt Philadelphia police officers and former colleagues of Mike Ehrmantraut 's son Matt .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: They profited from gang activity and offered Matt a cut of dirty money .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Matt initially refused and was pressured by Mike into accepting it , but the two crooked cops ambushed and killed Matt so he would not report them to their superiors .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Hoffman and Fensky covered their tracks , but Mike figured out they were responsible for murdering Matt and avenged Matt 's death by killing them .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Old Joe

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Old Joe ( played by Larry Hankin ) is the owner of a local junkyard .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: He aids Walt and Jesse on several occasions by using his car crusher in addition to sharing his knowledge of the legal limits on police procedure and evidence gathering .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: He also provides the magnet system used to wipe the evidence from Gus 's laptop , and constructs the portable laboratory equipment used in the Vamonos Pest undercover meth lab operation .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: In El Camino : A Breaking Bad Movie , Jesse contacts him in order to get rid of Todd 's El Camino , which Joe agrees to do for free .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: However , Joe discovers that the police just activated the LoJack GPS tracker , causing him to flee , while advising Jesse , Skinny Pete and Badger to do the same .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Julie Julie ( played by Audrey Moore ) is a secretary at Hamlin , Hamlin & McGill .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: She delivers documents and letters to employees and sometimes attends meetings with them .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Ken Ken ( played by Kyle Bornheimer ) is a stockbroker with an obnoxious personality .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: He drives a BMW convertible with a license plate reading " Ken Wins " and is often loudly boasting into his Bluetooth headset .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Ken steals Walter 's parking space at his credit union and annoys him with his phone conversation .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: When Walt later sees Ken pulling up at a gas station , he retaliates by shorting the battery of Ken 's unattended car with a squeegee , causing it to burst into flames .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Ken also appears in Better Call Saul , in which Jimmy and Kim con him into ordering expensive Zafiro Añejo tequila .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Betsy and Craig Kettleman

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Betsy Kettleman ( played by Julie Ann Emery ) and her husband Craig Kettleman ( played by Jeremy Shamos ) initially appear as clients of Hamlin , Hamlin & McGill ( HHM ) , and later Jimmy McGill .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Craig , the county treasurer , is being investigated for the disappearance of $ 1.6 million in government funds and considers hiring Jimmy .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: He and his wife meet with Jimmy at a diner but Betsy is hesitant .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: They decide to go to HHM , which angers Jimmy .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: A few days later , the Kettlemans receive an anonymous tip that their family is in danger .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: The call was made by Jimmy , who fears Nacho might hurt the family to steal the stolen cash .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: The Kettlemans and their children decide to stage a kidnapping and camp out in the hills behind their home .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Jimmy finds them and discovers they are in possession of the stolen cash .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: They pay him $ 30,000 to remain quiet .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: At a meeting with Kim Wexler of HHM , the Kettlemans consider a plea deal that includes return of the money and a sixteen - month prison sentence for Craig .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Betsy wants to go to trial but Kim tells her that Craig faces 30 years in prison if he is convicted .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Betsy rejects the plea deal , fires Kim , and hires Jimmy .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Jimmy counsels the Kettlemans to accept the plea bargain but Betsy once again refuses .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: She blackmails Jimmy into helping them by pointing out that returning the money will implicate him , since they gave him cash to maintain his silence .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: With Mike 's help , Jimmy steals the cash from the Kettlemans and delivers it to the prosecutor handling their case .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Betsy threatens to have Jimmy arrested by reporting the bribe he took but he responds that if he is guilty of taking a bribe , she is guilty of offering one .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Betsy and Craig reluctantly accept the plea deal Kim negotiated , realizing that having one parent go to prison is a better alternative than depriving their children of both parents .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: After Craig 's release from prison , the Kettlemans become proprietors of a shady tax preparation service .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Kim and Jimmy scheme to ruin Howard Hamlin 's reputation as part of their plan to force a resolution of the Sandpiper case so Jimmy can obtain his share of the multimillion - dollar judgment or settlement sooner .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: To that end , Jimmy cons the Kettlemans into believing they have grounds for a lawsuit against Howard .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: They attempt to hire Cliff Main to represent them by claiming that Howard provided ineffective counsel during Craig 's embezzlement case because he supposedly used cocaine .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Cliff declines to take the case , but as Jimmy and Kim intended , he begins to wonder if Howard is a drug user .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Jimmy subsequently attempts to bribe the Kettlemans to keep quiet about their role in smearing Howard , but when they refuse the cash Kim coerces them by threatening to report their tax preparation scam to the IRS .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: The Kettlemans are cowed into compliance , but Jimmy disappoints Kim by giving the Kettlemans the money anyway .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Lawson ( played by Jim Beaver ) is Walter White and Mike Ehrmantraut 's gun dealer .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: He sold Walt a .38 caliber snub handgun ( a Ruger LCR ) with the serial number filed off , and previously an M40A1 sniper rifle which Mike had intended to use to kill Tuco Salamanca and then Hector Salamanca .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Walt later purchases an M60 machine gun from Lawson , which he uses to kill Jack Welker and his gang .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Group Leader The Group Leader ( played by Jere Burns ) is a counselor who leads group therapy sessions at Narcotics Anonymous .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: His actual name is not revealed .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: He takes a calm , non-judgmental approach to leading discussions and emphasizes that those attending his sessions are there not to improve themselves , but to learn self - acceptance .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: During an outdoor session at a campfire , he reveals to Jesse and other recovering addicts that in July 1992 , while drunk on vodka and high on cocaine , he killed his six - year - old daughter by accidentally running her over with his car .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Jesse , still reeling from Jane 's death , asks the Group Leader how can he not hate himself for what happened .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: The Group Leader responds that self - hatred and guilt stand in the way of achieving true change .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: The Group Leader is seen again in Season 4 , when Jesse returns to a session distraught about killing Gale .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: During the session , Jesse breaks down and yells at the Group Leader , claiming that his philosophy about " accepting yourself " for making mistakes is wrong and people should be judged for the things they have done .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Jesse then asks the Group Leader if he just accepts himself for killing his daughter and admits to the whole group that the only reason he comes to these meetings in the first place is to sell meth to them .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: He asks the Group Leader if he is okay with that , to which the group leader responds , " No . "

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Jesse retorts , " About time " , and leaves the session , never to return .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Cal and Lars Lindholm Calvin " Cal " and Laurentius " Lars " Lindholm ( played by Daniel Spenser Levine and Steven Levine respectively ) are twin brothers and skateboarders who run scams in which they pretend to be hit by cars while skating and demand money .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: They try to scam Jimmy but he is not fooled .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Jimmy later plans to scam Betsy Kettleman in an attempt to convince her use his legal services and enlists Cal and Lars , but the skateboarders end up trying to scam another woman instead , who turns out to be Tuco Salamanca 's grandmother .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: This leads to Tuco capturing Jimmy and the twins and breaking the skateboarders ' legs after Jimmy persuades him not to kill them .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Donald Margolis

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Donald Margolis ( played by John de Lancie ) is Jane 's father .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: He owns the building his daughter managed for him .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: He sent Jane to rehab once before and goes with her to recovery meetings .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Donald becomes furious when he discovers that his daughter is back on heroin , suspecting Jesse is at fault ( in fact , it is the other way around ; she initiated Jesse to heroin , although they are both enabling each other ) .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: He nearly calls the police but relents when Jane promises to go back into rehab .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Depressed , he goes to a bar and strikes up a conversation with a stranger about the heartache of raising children — that stranger turns out to be Walter White , who has recently been blackmailed by Donald 's daughter Jane , although he does not realize the coincidence at the moment .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Donald 's words inspire Walter to help Jesse get clean from heroin .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Walt returns to Jesse 's apartment and witnesses Jane choking to death on her vomit while intoxicated on heroin .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Heartbroken , Donald is present when the paramedics remove Jane 's body and hardly reacts to Jesse 's presence .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: A month later , he returns to work as an air traffic controller while still distraught and causes a mid-air collision of two airplanes just above Albuquerque .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: The collision kills 167 people — which explains the recurring images in the Season 2 flash - forwards of a burned pink teddy bear floating in Walter 's pool .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Shortly after the incident , Walter hears via his in - car radio that Margolis is rushed to the hospital after a self - inflicted gunshot wound ; however , Walt turns the radio off before Margolis 's fate is revealed .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Later on , in the episode " Fly " , Walter recalls that unlikely sequence of events , telling Jesse about the encounter at the bar ( he only realized that this man was Jane 's father after he saw him on the news following the disaster ) , and wonders about the possible meaning of the coincidence .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Carmen Molina Carmen Molina ( played by Carmen Serano ) is the assistant principal at JP Wynne High School , where Walt teaches and which Walt Jr. attends .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: In Season 3 , Walt tries to seduce her ( as an attempt at revenge for Skyler 's infidelity with Ted ) , resulting in him being placed on an indefinite sabbatical .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: In Season 5 , she has been promoted to principal .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Mrs. Nguyen Mrs. Nguyen ( portrayed by Eileen Fogarty ) is the owner of Day Spa and Nail , the nail salon in which Jimmy McGill 's back room office is located .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: She frequently chides Jimmy for drinking the cucumber water infusion she makes available to salon customers and employees and objects to Jimmy 's clients waiting in the area where she provides services to hers .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: When Jimmy is hired by Davis & Main , his company car is delivered to Day Spa and Nail , and Mrs. Nguyen 's awestruck staff huddle around the new Mercedes sedan .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Before he departs , he jokingly asks if Mrs. Nguyen is going to give him a goodbye hug and she shakes her head no before walking back inside .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Jimmy finds himself unable to sleep in his new apartment , so he returns to the salon .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Mrs. Nguyen discovers him the next morning , and when she refuses him a cup of coffee , he tells her that the sooner she gives him the coffee , the sooner he will leave .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: During the suspension of his law license , Jimmy starts a business reselling prepaid cellular phones .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Mrs. Nguyen objects to him storing the phones at the salon , but Jimmy says that because he pays rent , he can do what he wants with the space .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: He appeases her by offering her a phone , which she accepts , but she also warns him that get rich quick schemes are usually unsuccessful .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: After Jimmy 's first bar association hearing , when he discovers his suspension will be continued and argues with Kim , Mrs. Nguyen discovers him crying in his office .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: She assumes Kim and Jimmy are married , shares a drink with him , and offers him relationship advice .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: After Jimmy begins practicing law as Saul Goodman , and word of his representation of the Salamancas gets out , his office is flooded with potential criminal defense clients , causing an obviously annoyed Mrs. Nguyen to evict him .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Pamela Pamela Orbic ( played by Julie Dretzin ) is a divorce attorney hired by Skyler in the third season .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Skyler confides in Pamela that Walter is a drug dealer , and Pamela urges her to contact the police .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Gretchen and Elliott Schwartz

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Gretchen Schwartz ( played by Jessica Hecht ) is Walt 's former college chemistry assistant and now co-owner of Gray Matter , a successful pharmaceutical company .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: A former romantic interest of Walter 's , she is married to Walter 's former partner and friend , Elliott Schwartz ( played by Adam Godley ) , who co-created Gray Matter .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: During their relationship , Gretchen took Walt to visit her parents over a weekend .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Soon afterwards , Walt suddenly left all his research and sold his ownership stake in Gray Matter .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Gretchen later married Elliott , and Gray Matter then became so successful that their company was worth 2.16 billion dollars by the time of the show , and Gretchen and Elliott became wealthy , leaving Walt bitter about their success .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: When Walt begins chemotherapy treatments for his cancer , he conceals the fact that he is paying for it with proceeds from his drug dealing by telling Skyler that Gretchen and Elliott are paying for it .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Gretchen finds Walt lied to his family , and is horrified when Walter angrily and bitterly blames her and Elliott for ruining his life .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Gretchen promises to maintain the lie for Walt as long as he tells Skyler that the Schwartzes can no longer fund his treatments .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Skyler becomes suspicious , contacts Gretchen , and learns that the Schwartzes did not pay any of Walt 's medical bills , and deduces that Walter must be getting the money through illegal means .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: In the series ' final two episodes , " Granite State " and " Felina " , Walt is in hiding in New Hampshire and preparing to turn himself in to the DEA .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: While at a bar , he sees an interview with the Schwartzes on Charlie Rose , who denounce Walt and minimize his involvement in starting Gray Matter .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Instead of waiting for the police , Walt steals a car and returns to New Mexico .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: At Gretchen and Elliott 's home , Walt claims to have snipers aiming rifles with laser sights at them , which he uses to coerce them into agreeing to use his remaining money to establish a trust for Walter Jr. while masking the source as a contribution from their charitable foundation .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Unknown to the Schwartzes , the snipers are actually Badger and Skinny Pete , who are using laser pointers to simulate rifle sights .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: The threat causes Gretchen and Elliott to agree to Walt 's demand .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Drew Sharp Drew Sharp ( played by Samuel Webb ) is an inquisitive teenager living in McKinley County in northwestern New Mexico .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: In the opening scenes of " Dead Freight " , Sharp is on his motorcycle riding around the desert scrub .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: He finds a tarantula , which he places in a jar ; he then hears a train coming down the tracks and sets off to see it , only to encounter Walter White , Jesse Pinkman , and Todd Alquist as they are celebrating their success in stealing the methylamine from the tanker car on the train Kuby helped them stop .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Walt , Jesse , and Todd turn off the engine to their pump and discover Sharp and his motorcycle on the other side of the trestle .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: When Sharp waves hello , Todd waves back then pulls out his pistol and kills Sharp in cold blood , to Jesse 's dismay .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Sharp 's body and motorcycle are hauled back to Vamonos Pest in Albuquerque , where Walter , Mike and Todd dispose of them , once again using hydrofluoric acid , and Todd keeps the tarantula .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Later on in that episode , KOB Reporter Antoinette Antonio reports on the disappearance of Sharp and how the search for Sharp has now expanded beyond McKinley County .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: The killing of Sharp is a critical turning point for Jesse , who ultimately severs his ties with Walter 's operation due to his horror and grief at the young boy 's death .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: After Walter belatedly leaves Jesse his share of the buyout money , Jesse seeks Saul Goodman 's help to send half of the $ 5 million to Sharp 's family , but is rebuffed as such a move would draw the attention of the authorities .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: The murder of Sharp is mentioned in the tape Hank and Gomez make of Jesse confessing to his and Walter 's criminal history .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: In El Camino : A Breaking Bad Movie , it is revealed that Todd kept Drew 's tarantula at his apartment .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Sobchak ( played by Steven Ogg ) is a criminal and " off the books " investigator .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Pryce considered him , Mike , and Man Mountain as bodyguards when Pryce first met with Nacho .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Man Mountain fled after Mike disarmed Sobchak .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Kim and Jimmy later hire Sobchak ( under his " professional " name Mr. X ) to find " dirt " on Kevin Wachtell .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: He tells them that he could " take him out to the desert " to acquire more information , which causes Kim and Jimmy to ask him to leave .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Spooge Spooge ( played by David Ury ) is a drug addict who steals meth from Skinny Pete at knifepoint .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Jesse later accosts Spooge in Spooge 's house and attempts to retrieve the stolen drugs or cash payment .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Spooge attempts to repay Jesse by breaking open an ATM he has stolen from a convenience store .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: While attempting to drill into the machine from the bottom , he begins verbally abusing his wife ( played by Dale Dickey ) , who tips the ATM , crushing Spooge 's head and killing him instantly .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Jesse 's associates and rivals attribute Spooge 's death to Jesse , which strengthens his street credibility and reputation for ruthlessness until the wife confesses .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Spooge has a young son , whose neglect causes Jesse to realize the negative consequences of the drug business .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: After Spooge 's death , Jesse sits the boy on the front steps of the home , instructs him not to go back inside , having called 911 and leaves the phone line open so police can trace the call , making sure that the boy will be cared for .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: In Better Call Saul , Spooge is one of the first clients seeking to engage Jimmy McGill as Saul Goodman after word gets out to Albuquerque 's criminals about Saul 's defense of Lalo Salamanca .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Mr. Ughetta Mr. Ughetta ( portrayed by Michael Chieffo ) is a commissioner of the New Mexico Banking Board .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: He and fellow board members meet with Chuck and Howard , along with their clients Kevin and Paige , over Mesa Verde Bank 's proposed branch in Scottsdale , Arizona .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Ughetta and the rest of the board decide to postpone the application for six weeks due to the address in the documents being forged by Jimmy .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Manuel Varga Manuel Varga ( portrayed by Juan Carlos Cantú ) is Nacho Varga 's father and the owner of an upholstery shop .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Nacho has gone to great lengths to prevent Manuel from learning about his role in the Salamanca drug trade , but as Gus starts to undermine the routes the Salamancas use to smuggle drugs into the U.S. , Hector Salamanca considers using Manuel 's shop as a front .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Nacho is forced to reveal his role in the Salamanca organization to Manuel so Manuel will not put himself at risk by rejecting Hector 's offer out of hand .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: When Nacho is shot as part of Gus 's plan to undermine the Salamancas , a reluctant Manuel allows Nacho to recuperate at his house .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: When Gus forces Nacho to work as his mole , Nacho hides cash and fake Canadian ID cards for himself and his father so they can flee Albuquerque if necessary .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: When Lalo Salamanca arrives to take over the Salamanca operation , Gus threatens Manuel 's life to coerce Nacho into providing inside information .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Nacho attempts to protect him by having an associate offer to buy Manuel 's shop for more than it is worth so Manuel can retire and move from Albuquerque .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Manuel guesses that Nacho is behind the offer and confronts him , saying that if Nacho 's drug dealing has made him fearful , he should flee or turn himself into authorities , but that Manuel will not sell and will not leave .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: After Gus 's attempt to kill Lalo he deflects blame by implicating Nacho , and the cartel places a bounty on him .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Nacho realizes telling the Salamancas and cartel leaders that Gus had no role in the attack on Lalo is the only way to protect Manuel , but will also result in his own death .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: He places a farewell call to Manuel , then surrenders to Gus in exchange for Mike 's guarantee of Manuel 's safety .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Mike later informs Manuel of Nacho 's death and promises revenge on the Salamancas .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Manuel dismisses Mike 's promise as a never - ending cycle of bloodshed and tells him he is no different from the criminals with whom he associates .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Kevin Wachtell

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Kevin Wachtell ( portrayed by Rex Linn ) is the CEO of Mesa Verde Bank .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: He took over the bank from his father Don in the early 2000s and presides over its expansion into a large regional institution .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Kim uses her acquaintanceship with Mesa Verde 's counsel Paige to secure Mesa Verde as a client for Hamlin , Hamlin & McGill .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: When Kim leaves HHM , Kevin agrees that Mesa Verde will be a client of her new practice , but Chuck succeeds at winning them back .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Jimmy 's sabotage of Chuck 's Mesa Verde work causes Kevin to take the bank 's business back to Kim .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Kim later uses her relationship with Kevin to become a partner at Schweikart & Cokely ( S&C ) and lead the firm 's new banking division .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Kevin 's stubborn refusal to accept Kim 's advice on handling the eviction of Everett Acker causes Kim to turn the Mesa Verde account over to S&C and leave the firm to concentrate on pro bono criminal defense work she finds more interesting than banking law .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Fred Whalen

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Fred Whalen ( portrayed by James Austin Johnson ) is an employee of Albuquerque TravelWire , a wire transfer agency .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Mike Ehrmantraut questions Fred about Werner Ziegler 's whereabouts in " Winner " .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Fred is initially hesitant , but after Mike claims Werner is his missing brother - in - law and has early - stage dementia and diabetes , Fred reveals that Werner made phone calls at TravelWire and left using a car service .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Fred also lets Mike review CCTV footage in hopes of learning Werner 's destination .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Lalo Salamanca later visits TravelWire and asks similar questions about Werner .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Fred becomes suspicious and declines to cooperate .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: After Fred suggests that Lalo call the police , TravelWire gets a call .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: When Fred finishes the call , he sees that Lalo is no longer in the store 's lobby .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Just as Fred notices a loose ceiling panel inside his locked booth , Lalo drops in and trains a gun on him .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Lalo examines the footage , murders Fred , and burns down the TravelWire to destroy the evidence .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: In " Wexler v. Goodman " , Mike works under an assumed name to persuade a witness who was outside TravelWire to identify Lalo 's car to the Albuquerque police and Lalo is arrested under an alias .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: A police report reveals that Lalo had bludgeoned Fred to death , resulting in a skull fracture .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: In " JMM " , Gus wants Lalo released , so he has Mike provide Saul details of the actions that led to Lalo 's arrest .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Fred 's family attends the bail hearing , at which Saul accuses the police of witness tampering , evidence that results in the judge granting bail to Lalo .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Holly White Holly White ( played by Haven Tomlin in Season 4 , Elanor Anne Wenrich in the first half of Season 5 , and Moira Bryg MacDonald in the latter half ) is Skyler and Walt 's infant daughter and Walt Jr. 's younger sister .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Walt is not present for his daughter 's birth because he is preoccupied with drug - related business , and he blames Jesse for making him miss the birth .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Ted Beneke , Skyler 's boss , takes Skyler to the hospital when she goes into labor .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Skyler brings the baby on her trip to the Four Corners Monument .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Holly is seen learning to walk in Season 5 .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Holly and her brother spend three months in the home of their Aunt Marie and Uncle Hank while their parents work to determine the state of their marriage .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: After her Uncle Hank 's unexpected death , which causes a nasty fight between Walter and Skyler , Walter kidnaps Holly to " punish "

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Skyler for attempting to stab him , but later has second thoughts and leaves her at a fire station .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: She is later returned safely to Skyler .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Holly 's last appearance occurs in " Felina " where Walter , via a request that is granted by Skyler , holds and embraces her for a moment before he leaves .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Bogdan Wolynetz Bogdan Wolynetz ( played by Marius Stan ) is the owner and proprietor of the car wash at which Walt is employed at the beginning of Breaking Bad .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: He is abrasive and rude to Walter , who finds this job degrading and tedious .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: After Walt is diagnosed with lung cancer in the pilot episode , he angrily lashes out at Bogdan and quits .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Bogdan reappears in the third season , when Walt and Skyler are trying to purchase the car wash in order to launder Walt 's drug money .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: When Skyler is trying to negotiate the purchase , Bogdan brings up Walt 's angry outburst and states that , if Walt wants to purchase the establishment it will cost him $ 20 million .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: When Saul suggests that Walt and Skyler could accuse Bogdan of harboring Islamist terrorists in order to force him to sell the car wash , Walt exasperatedly reveals that Bogdan is , in fact , Romanian .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Eventually , Walt and Skyler are able to purchase it for $ 800,000 after Skyler hires Kuby to perform a fake environmental audit on the car wash .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: When Bogdan hands the keys to the building over to Walter , he taunts Walter by implying that he needs his " woman " to do things for him .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Walter , having been riled up by Bogdan , refuses to let him leave with his first American business dollar which had been framed and mounted in his shop .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Subsequently , Walter spends that dollar in the vending machine to buy a can of soda .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Daniel Wormald

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Daniel Wormald ( played by Mark Proksch ) , who uses the alias " Pryce " , is a quirky , nerdy and naive man who works for a pharmaceutical company .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: To earn extra money , he steals some of his company 's pills to sell to Nacho and hires Mike to provide security .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Knowing that Nacho is going behind the cartel 's back and wants to avoid attention , Mike assures that he abides by the terms of the deal .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Daniel uses the money to buy a flashy Hummer and when he arranges another deal , Mike refuses to be a part of it .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Daniel still meets Nacho , but without Mike to protect him , Nacho obtains Daniel 's address .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Nacho later breaks into Daniel 's home to steal Daniel 's cash , pill stash , and a collection of baseball cards .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Daniel calls the police to report the stolen cards but his awkward behavior leads the cops to find the hiding place where he kept the cash and pills .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: To keep Daniel from talking , Mike brokers a deal that has Nacho exchange cash and the baseball cards for Daniel 's Hummer .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Mike also arranges for Jimmy to represent Daniel during an interview with police .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Jimmy allays their suspicions by claiming the hiding place was full of " squat cobbler " fetish videos of Daniel sitting on pies and the break - in was a lover 's quarrel with the man who commissions the videos .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Nacho breaks into Daniel 's home again , this time offering Daniel $ 20,000 if he can procure empty capsules that look like Hector 's angina medication .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Daniel approaches Mike for help and Mike declines .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Mike changes his mind after comparing the risk an unprotected Daniel will face to the risk Mike created for his daughter - in - law and granddaughter by his recent actions against the Salamancas .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Mike delivers the empty capsules to Nacho , who explains his plan to switch Hector 's nitroglycerin for a placebo .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Mike warns Nacho that if Hector dies , Nacho should immediately take the fakes from Hector and replace them with the real medication so that the cause of Hector 's death will not be obvious .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: According to the Better Call Saul Insider Podcast , the " Danny " referenced by Jimmy on his call to Francesca is intended to be Daniel , meaning Daniel owns the laser tag arena / arcade through which Jimmy tells Walt and Jesse to launder their money .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Margarethe Ziegler Margarethe Ziegler ( portrayed by Andrea Sooch ) is the widow of Werner Ziegler .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: While Werner is constructing the meth lab for Gus Fring , he escapes to rendezvous with Margarethe , as she plans to visit him in New Mexico .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: After Werner inadvertently reveals construction details to Lalo , Gus realizes that Lalo could learn the whole plan and report him to cartel leaders , so he orders Werner 's death .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Because Werner escaped on his watch , Mike takes responsibility .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: After promising Werner his crew would be returned to Germany unharmed and that there will be a story about his death that satisfies his wife , Mike has Werner call his wife at the airport and convince her to return to Germany .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Mike then shoots Werner , and his death is made to look like the result of a construction accident .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Lalo later uses an alias to converse with Margarethe at a bar in Germany and finds that she believes Werner died in a cave in , but saved his crew .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: The next day , Lalo watches Margarethe leave for work , then breaks into her home .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Using a clue she provided in their conversation the night before , Lalo finds another lead that will enable him to find Werner 's crew .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Margarethe unexpectedly returns home to retrieve her cell phone , and her dog barks at something upstairs .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Margarethe ascends the stairs to search , and Lalo prepares to kill her , but he escapes through a window without being noticed .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Neil Kandy Neil Kandy ( portrayed by Scott MacArthur ) is the owner of an Albuquerque welding shop who appears in El Camino as the main antagonist .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: In the film , Neil and his accomplice Casey pretend to be police officers so they can enter the now - dead Todd 's apartment to search for his hidden cash .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: They encounter Jesse , who was already there searching and prevents them from killing him by revealing that he found the money .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Neil and Jesse bargain over the cash , and in order to avoid raising the suspicions of Todd 's neighbors Neil agrees to let Jesse leave with a third .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: As they depart Todd 's apartment building , Jesse recognizes Neil as the welder who built the tether that held him while he was forced to cook meth for the Brotherhood .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: When Jesse realizes he does not have enough to pay for Ed Galbraith 's new identity services , he secretly retrieves two pistols from his parents ' house , a Colt Woodsman and an Iver Johnson Hammerless .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: He then drives to Neil 's shop , where Neil , Casey , and three friends celebrate with escorts and cocaine .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: After the escorts leave , Jesse asks for the $ 1,800 he needs , and Neil refuses .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Seeing the Woodsman in Jesse 's waistband , Neil challenges Jesse to a duel for his share of the cash .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Jesse agrees , and when Neil reaches for his gun , Jesse shoots Neil with the Hammerless , which was concealed in his jacket pocket .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: After killing Casey , Jesse collects the driver 's licenses of the remaining men and lets them leave after threatening to return and kill them if they tell the police .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: He recovers Neil 's cash and departs after setting an explosion to cover his tracks .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Casey ( portrayed by Scott Shepherd ) is an employee at Neil Kandy 's welding shop .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: In El Camino , after Casey and Neil confront Jesse during the search for Todd 's hidden cash , Jesse saves himself by revealing that he found it .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Casey then distracts Todd 's busybody neighbor Lou , which enables Jesse and Neil to bargain .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: To avoid alarming Todd 's neighbors , Neil agrees to let Jesse leave with a third .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: When Jesse later arrives at Neil 's shop to ask for the $ 1,800 he needs to pay Ed Galbraith for a new identity and relocation , Casey is incensed to learn that Neil allowed Jesse to keep a third of the money and demands that he not give Jesse any more .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Neil challenges Jesse to a duel for his share of the cash , during which Jesse kills Neil .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Casey then fires at Jesse , but Jesse kills him with Neil 's gun .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Lou Schanzer Lou Schanzer ( portrayed by Tom Bower ) is a retired police officer and Todd Alquist 's busybody neighbor .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: In El Camino , he observed Neil Kandy and Casey arrive at Todd 's apartment to search for Todd 's hidden money , though Neil and Casey had planned their arrival for a time when they thought he would not be home .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Believing Neil and Casey to be police officers , he offers information about Todd 's activities .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: After he leaves , Neil and Casey confront Jesse .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Lou then arrives with an old note from Todd , which he believes will help Neil and Casey in their investigation .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Casey pretends to be interested to divert Lou 's attention , which enables Jesse and Neil to negotiate over the division of the cash , then leave Todd 's apartment building .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Marion ( portrayed by Carol Burnett ) is Jeff 's elderly mother , whom Jimmy ( as Gene ) befriends as a ploy to gain the upper hand on Jeff .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Gene puts on a kind and affable persona and lies about owning a missing dog .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: In addition , he claims to have never visited Albuquerque , where Marion says Jeff faced legal troubles .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: After Gene , Jeff and Jeff 's friend Buddy secretly work together to rob a department store at the mall where Gene works , Jeff uses some of his money to buy Marion a laptop ; Gene teaches her how to search on a web browser .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: While watching videos one night , Marion overhears Gene berating Buddy because Buddy has backed out of Gene 's latest scam .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Gene refuses to give up on robbing the mark , so he has Jeff drive him to the mark 's home .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Jeff panics when he sees a police car idle behind him and crashes his taxi , leading to his arrest .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Gene asks Marion to accompany him when delivering Jeff 's bail .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Gene 's knowledge of the legal process arouses Marion 's suspicions , and she uses her computer to discover Gene 's identity as Saul Goodman .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: Gene attempts to intimidate her into staying silent , but she uses her Life Alert button to call the authorities , forcing Gene to flee .

source.page_title: List of characters in the Breaking Bad franchise

text: As he runs , Marion provides the operator information on Gene 's movements that aids police in locating and arresting him .

text: There are 13 lakes of at least five acres ( two hectares ) within the borders of Minneapolis in the U.S. state of Minnesota .

source.page_title: List of lakes in Minneapolis

text: Of these , Bde Maka Ska is the largest and deepest , covering 421 acres ( 170.37 ha ) with a maximum depth of 89.9 feet ( 27.4 m ) .

source.page_title: List of lakes in Minneapolis

text: Lake Hiawatha , through which Minnehaha Creek flows , has a watershed of 115,840 acres ( 468.79 km 2 ) , two orders of magnitude larger than the next largest watershed in the city .

source.page_title: List of lakes in Minneapolis

text: Ryan Lake , in the city 's north , sits partially in Minneapolis and partially in neighboring Robbinsdale .

source.page_title: List of lakes in Minneapolis

text: Certain other bodies of water are counted on some lists of Minneapolitan lakes , though they may fall outside the city limits or cover fewer than five acres .

source.page_title: List of lakes in Minneapolis

text: Many of Minneapolis 's lakes formed in the depressions left by large blocks of ice after the retreat of the Laurentide Ice Sheet at the end of the last glacial period and now overlie sandy or loamy soils .

source.page_title: List of lakes in Minneapolis

text: Before the appearance of white settlers , the Dakota harvested wild rice from the lakes .

source.page_title: List of lakes in Minneapolis

text: In the early 1800s , the lakes ' shorelines were marshy , deterring large - scale settlement and development by white residents though an experimental Dakota agricultural community , Ḣeyate Otuŋwe , was founded on the banks of Bde Maka Ska by Maḣpiya Wic̣aṡṭa in 1829 .

source.page_title: List of lakes in Minneapolis

text: In the 1880s , landscape architect Horace Cleveland foresaw Minneapolis 's growth and made a series of recommendations to the city 's Board of Park Commissioners to acquire land along Minnehaha Creek , near Minnehaha Falls , and around several lakes in the southwest portion of the city in order to form a robust , interconnected park system that would aesthetically and morally benefit the city 's residents .

source.page_title: List of lakes in Minneapolis

text: Board president Charles M. Loring heeded Cleveland 's advice and bought the land , later developed into a robust system of parks by Theodore Wirth .

source.page_title: List of lakes in Minneapolis

text: During this time , many of the lakes were reformed by the Board of Park Commissioners through draining , dredging , shoreline stabilization , and the construction of parkways around their perimeters .

source.page_title: List of lakes in Minneapolis

text: Property in neighborhoods surrounding the lakes grew desirable , especially by the " Chain of Lakes " , five lakes in the southwestern portion of the city ( Maka Ska , Harriet , Isles , Cedar , and Brownie ) that were joined by artificial channels .

source.page_title: List of lakes in Minneapolis

text: Various municipal symbols and icons reference the presence of the lakes in Minneapolitan life and culture , from the sailboat in the city 's logo to the ship 's wheel on its flag to Minneapolis 's nickname , the " City of Lakes " .

source.page_title: List of lakes in Minneapolis

text: Much of Minneapolis 's lakeshore is public parkland , in contrast to other American cities where lakeside property tends to be privately controlled .

source.page_title: List of lakes in Minneapolis

text: Since they were dredged , the lakes have drawn city residents for recreation and sport including swimming , sailing , yachting , canoeing , biking , jogging , and ice skating .

source.page_title: List of lakes in Minneapolis

text: The 76 - mile ( 122.3 km ) Grand Rounds National Scenic Byway passes around many of Minneapolis 's lakes .
